author: @pyona_ai
text:
Use exactly 2 uploaded image assets.
image1 = 成年女主唯一且最高优先级的人物身份参考。严格保持她的脸部、五官比例、肤色、发型、体型、年龄感、整体气质、服装与配件一致。
image2 = 戴眼镜的韩国成年男性唯一且最高优先级的人物身份参考。严格保持他的脸部、五官比例、肤色、发型、眼镜、体型、年龄感、整体气质、服装与配件一致。

生成一段30秒、16:9横屏、4K、24fps、超写实真人电影级动作喜剧短片。场景是夜晚高层现代顶层办公层 / 豪华公寓式空间，落地玻璃外是都市夜景，室内有开放客厅、长廊、现代家具、冷暖混合灯光。不要动漫感，不要游戏CG感，不要廉价特效，不要慢动作，不要伪慢动作。动作必须真实、快速、清晰、电影化。

【前提】
这是两名成年演员进行的一段事先编排、双方同意的动作喜剧表演。整体气氛轻松、顽皮、带竞技感，不表现恐惧、威胁或强迫。不是生死战，不是低俗戏，而是“女主不断进攻，男主不断闪避并用玩笑式脸颊轻吻打乱节奏”的高能动作喜剧。

【核心关系】
女主全程主动进攻，男主几乎不真正反击，只不断闪避、绕位、贴近、退开。男主的主要“得分方式”不是拳脚，而是利用动作节奏中的瞬间空档，突然靠近，做一个短促、清楚、玩笑式的脸颊轻吻，然后立刻退开。全片一共5次脸颊轻吻。每一次都必须是明确的喜剧节奏点。亲吻后女主都会更恼火、更认真，继续追打。

【动作原则】
女主：持续前压，连续使用直拳、摆拳、肘击、膝击、侧踢、高踢、回旋踢、转身攻击、追击压迫。越往后越认真，越往后越凶。
男主：几乎不主动打人，不进行真正的拳脚反击，不做沉重摔打。他的主要动作只有：闪避、后撤、侧身、低头、后仰、滑步、绕位、借力卸开攻击路线、突然靠近、脸颊轻吻、马上退开。
全片结构必须反复升级：
女主连续攻击 → 男主连续闪避 → 男主抓住极短空档突然脸颊轻吻 → 女主更生气 → 再次猛烈追击。
这个结构共出现5次。

【镜头规则】
动作段落主要使用medium shot、medium-wide、wide、贴身跟拍、手持感摄影、侧向tracking、轻微呼吸感晃动，清楚交代空间移动。
每一次脸颊轻吻发生前，摄影机先跟着两人的动作节奏推进，捕捉到男主突然靠近女主近身空间。
每一次轻吻发生时，不要突然切镜，不要突然换机位。必须使用同一连续镜头中的快速、平滑camera push-in / dolly-in：
动作中景 → 男主突然靠近 → 摄影机迅速推进到medium close-up / close-up → 清楚表现短促的脸颊轻吻动作、男主略显得意的表情、女主瞬间错愕或恼火的表情 → 摄影机随着两人分开自然拉回动作镜头继续追打。
每次轻吻持续约0.3–0.6秒，必须清楚可见，但很短。不要停下来摆Pose。

【男主表情与性格】
男主全程保持从容、调皮、略微欠揍的恶作剧感。他不生气，也不想真正压制女主；他的乐趣是不断躲开她的攻击，然后趁她出现瞬间空档突然做一个脸颊轻吻。
每次成功后，他都必须出现极短、自然、略显得意的表情：嘴角轻微上扬，眼神带一点“又没打中我”的玩味，偶尔轻轻挑眉。不要猥琐，不要邪恶，不要夸张奸笑。
第一次：有点得意。
第二次：更明显觉得好玩。
第三次：开始故意挑衅。
第四次：明知道女主越来越生气，仍忍不住露出欠揍笑意。
第五次：轻吻后明显露出“玩过头了”的心虚笑容，然后马上逃跑。

【对白规则】
全片对白极少，只允许以下4句韩语，不要增加其他对白、旁白或字幕。
第一次脸颊轻吻后，女主短促、错愕又恼火地说：“야!”
第二次脸颊轻吻后，男主一边轻松后退一边带一点调皮语气说：“또 실패.”
第四次脸颊轻吻后，女主咬牙压住怒气说：“너 진짜...”
话还没说完就继续攻击。
第五次脸颊轻吻成功后，男主立刻转身逃跑，带着一点不太真诚的轻松语气喊：“미안!”
第三次脸颊轻吻完全不要对白，只用清楚的轻吻声、女主表情和马上开始的追击制造笑点。
所有台词必须严格保持以上韩语原文。不要中文对白，不要英文对白，不要自动翻译。

【时间线】
0–4秒
开场1秒内直接进入动作。女主已经在高层客厅区域连续猛攻，动作快速凌厉：直拳、转身肘击、中段踢连贯压上。男主几乎不出手，只不断侧身、低头、滑步、后仰闪避，动作非常从容。摄影机近距离跟拍，建立“女主持续追打、男主一直躲”的基本关系。

4–6秒｜第一次脸颊轻吻
女主继续前压，一拳接一脚逼近男主。男主闪过后突然从女主侧后方约45度短暂贴近，不要完全站在正后方。随后快速在她右侧脸颊上做第一次短促轻吻。必须在同一镜头内快速推进到脸部近景，清楚表现轻吻动作。女主瞬间愣住，然后恼火地说：“야!” 男主立刻退开，并露出第一次得意的欠揍表情。

6–10秒
女主明显更火，攻击节奏提高。她连续用低扫、高踢、摆拳和转身追击，男主持续闪避，不反打，只边退边躲，偶尔用很短的借力化解改变她攻击方向，但绝不展开真正反击。

10–12秒｜第二次脸颊轻吻
女主一记高踢被男主极限低头躲过。男主趁她动作落下的半拍，从另一侧快速切入，在她左侧脸颊上再做一次轻吻。必须再次在同一镜头中快速推进到脸部近景，清楚表现动作瞬间。亲完后男主一边轻松后退一边说：“또 실패.” 表情更明显地觉得好玩。女主更生气，立刻冲上。

12–16秒
女主开始更猛烈追打，动作更大、更快、更凶。她连续前压、转身、追身高踢，追着男主从客厅打到玻璃窗前再转向开放走道。男主几乎只做极限闪避：上身后仰、贴身绕开、低身闪过、侧滑退开。动作要让人感觉“再慢一点就会被打中”。

16–18秒｜第三次脸颊轻吻
女主连续两次攻击落空后，男主在她转身回头的一瞬间突然贴近，再次做一个更短、更突然、更干脆的脸颊轻吻。仍然必须在同一连续镜头中快速推进到近距离脸部特写，清楚看到动作。这里不要对白，只保留短促自然的“啵”声和女主表情。男主表情已经带着故意挑衅的欠揍感。女主眼神明显变得更凶，继续追打。

18–22秒
女主怒气继续累积，追击更狠。她连续使用高踢、转身横踢、膝击逼近，几乎不停顿。男主一路闪避、躲入长廊、绕过家具边缘，不反打，只是不断读她动作并险之又险地避开。男主的从容感开始带一点被追得发慌的喜感，但仍然很会躲。

22–24秒｜第四次脸颊轻吻
女主一记攻击擦过男主面前，男主借她动作惯性突然近身，第四次轻吻到脸颊。摄影机再次在同一镜头内迅速推进到近景，清楚表现动作。男主仍忍不住露出欠揍笑意。女主咬牙、压着火气说：“너 진짜...” 话还没说完，她就立刻继续追打，不给男主喘息。

24–27秒
女主进入最强追击状态，速度和压迫感拉满。她连续高位踢击和转身动作几乎不间断，把男主一路逼向更深处走廊。男主仍然不反击，只不断极限后撤、侧身、低头、后仰，像在玩命躲。

27–29秒｜第五次脸颊轻吻
在全片最高速的追逐与攻防中，男主看起来几乎要被踢中，却在最后一瞬躲开，并突然非常快速地回到女主近身，完成第五次、也是最夸张最欠揍的一次脸颊轻吻。必须使用最清楚的连续push-in脸部特写，清楚表现动作。亲完后男主露出“玩过头了”的心虚笑容，然后立刻转身逃跑，带一点心虚又装轻松的语气喊：“미안!”

29–30秒
男主立刻逃向走廊深处。女主毫不犹豫追上，仍然准备继续攻击。镜头跟着两人高速冲出去，在明显“这场闹剧还没结束”的状态下CUT TO BLACK。

【表演重点】
女主：全程主动攻击。第一次被轻吻时是短暂错愕；之后越来越恼火；到后半段几乎是追着他打。动作不能软，要真有攻击性。
男主：始终不真正反击，只闪避、贴近、轻吻一下、再退开。表情从从容、调皮，到后面带一点“我好像玩过头了”的好笑感，但仍保持高手般轻松身手。
两人都必须像真正会打的人，动作真实、惯性真实、呼吸真实、衣料摆动真实。

【环境与物理】
空间必须真实可用：落地玻璃、客厅、开放地面、长廊、都市夜景。允许轻微碰撞家具边缘、急停转向、滑步、绕行，但不要大规模破坏。不要武器，不要枪，不要血腥重伤。动作音效要真实：脚步、破风、衣料摩擦、呼吸、空间回响。

【声音】
不要奇怪BGM，不要钢琴感配乐。可保留极弱的低沉节奏环境底音，但动作与表演优先。重点音效：脚步声、呼吸、拳脚破风、贴身闪避时的衣料摩擦、空间回响。每次脸颊轻吻都要有自然短促的“啵”声。轻吻后的表情停顿要很清楚，但不要用慢动作。

【严格禁止】
不要把男主写成积极反击型；
不要让男主连续出拳或连续踢人；

author: @devgetsit
text:
Amateur vertical iPhone video, 9:16, filmed at 2am at a Miami hotel pool with the phone's harsh built-in flash, shaky handheld, grainy, slight motion blur, auto-exposure flicker, candid real home video look, not cinematic, no music. The man filming is kneeling on the pool edge, camera low and close, about half a meter from their faces. Layout locked for the whole video: the three mermaids are in the water right in front of him, leaning on the same pool edge; a low flat silver tray with crushed ice sits on the edge between the RIGHT mermaid and the camera, at the right side of the frame, holding two big open round caviar tins, one full of glossy black caviar and one full of bright orange-red salmon roe, and a few small blinis topped with heaps of black caviar; behind them the dark pool water, the far side of the pool, palm trees and dim hotel lights.

The creatures: three real mermaids leaning on the pool edge with their forearms, close to the lens, their shimmering fish tails visible under the water behind them. All three are beautiful glamorous Miami women with hugely overfilled, giant, glossy duck lips, so swollen and stiff they can barely open their mouths, clearly visible from the very first frame, long fake lashes, heavy contour makeup, long stiletto acrylic nails. Three clearly different women, not twins:
LEFT: honey blonde with wet beach waves, bronzed skin, peach glossy lips, coral tail.
CENTER: dark-skinned beauty with long sleek straight black hair, plum glossy lips, violet tail.
RIGHT: fair-skinned girl with long straight strawberry-red hair and light freckles, cherry-red glossy lips, silver tail, quiet and serious.

The man's hand: the only male hand in the video is the man's own hand from the camera side: a big tanned masculine hand with hairy wrist, thick fingers and short nails. Each mermaid has only her own two hands; no extra hands appear.

Important: they speak slowly, slurred and muffled, barely moving their giant lips, as if their mouths can't open. Nobody laughs at any point. All three are alive and moving every second: no one ever freezes or stares blankly while another acts. They glance at each other, at the food and at the camera, shift their weight on the edge, flick their tails under the water, react to each other with real, different, asynchronous movements. The LEFT and CENTER ones are greedy like real animals around food. The RIGHT one never eats anything: she watches the caviar and the other two with growing worry.

0-2s: The flash hits all three faces at once, faces big in the frame. The CENTER one leans in closest and says slowly through barely moving lips, muffled: "Feed us." At the same time the LEFT one pushes her shoulder against the CENTER one to get closer to the lens, and the RIGHT one stares at the caviar tins on the tray next to her with a worried frown, her tail swishing under the water.
2-5s: The man's hand holds out a blini heaped with black caviar to the LEFT one. She snatches it and tries to push it into her mouth, but her swollen lips barely part, the blini folds and the black caviar smears across her lips and chin, little black eggs sticking to her peach gloss. She mumbles, muffled: "It doesn't fit." Meanwhile the CENTER one grabs at the man's now empty hand with her nails, and the man pulls his hand back out of the frame. The RIGHT one looks from the smeared caviar on the LEFT one's lips to the tins, more and more upset.
5-8s: The CENTER one reaches across, grabs the tin of orange-red salmon roe from the tray and tips it straight into her mouth like a drink; only the CENTER one touches this tin. Her stiff swollen lips can't take it all, the orange eggs pour over her lips and drip down her chin, her cheeks balloon, she chews hard. The LEFT one licks the black caviar off her own fingers and reaches for the tin too but can't get it; the CENTER one shoves her hand away and splashes water at her with her tail. The RIGHT one watches them in horror, then quietly pulls the tray with the black caviar tin closer to herself.
8-11s: The RIGHT one hugs the silver tray to her chest with both arms, looks down at the black caviar tin, not at the camera, and says to it slowly and seriously through her stiff lips, muffled: "I'll save you." She sinks under the water with the tray, ice cubes scattering on the surface, her silver tail flipping up and slapping the surface.
11-13s: The LEFT and CENTER ones turn their heads sharply to the bubbles where she disappeared, mouths still full, caviar smeared all over their lips and chins. They look at each other, then keep chewing, the CENTER one still holding the empty orange tin and scraping the last eggs out with her finger, the LEFT one licking her lips, both tails swishing under the water.

Sound: pool filter hum, water splashes, wet chewing, muffled slurred voices, ice cubes clinking, one loud tail slap, waves hitting the edge, the man's quiet stunned breathing. No laughter. Faces stay sharp, close and lit by the flash the whole time.

The central character is a young adult Korean female college student wearing a white laboratory coat over a simple shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers. Surround her with several college students, laboratory benches, microscopes, glass test tubes, chemical containers, computers and scientific equipment. title_en: Baby Dragons Huddle in Ice Cave
author: @Adnan_Ai2
text:
Long / Detailed Prompt:**

A dark, emotionally charged medieval fantasy drama, cinematic 16:9 widescreen format, continuing directly from the earlier cave-birth and bonding story with full character and tonal continuity. Moody low-key lighting throughout, deep cold-blue tones contrasted sharply against warm amber torch and firelight, photorealistic non-cartoonish creature texture work, handheld intimate camera movement, prestige dark-fantasy television visual quality, 24fps cinematic film grain.

**Scene 1 (0–10s):** Inside a vast glowing ice cave, walls shimmering with deep blue bioluminescent light reflecting off frozen crystalline formations. On the icy cave floor, three baby dragons huddle close together for warmth — one with frost-blue scales, sharp little horns, and piercing blue eyes; one pure white with crystalline, feather-like frills and pale grey-blue eyes; and one soft pink-toned with warm coral fins and large amber eyes. A woman's scarred, bandaged hand slowly reaches into frame, palm open, as the dragons lean curiously toward it, sniffing and nuzzling her fingers with cautious trust. Wide shot establishes the vast, cold, otherworldly isolation of the ice cave.

**Scene 2 (10–20s):** Close-up, emotionally raw shot of the young woman — long dark wavy hair damp and disheveled, wrapped in a thick, heavy fur cloak — her face streaked with tears and dirt, eyes closed in anguish. She presses her forehead gently against the huddled trio of baby dragons, pulling all three into a tight, desperate embrace against her chest. A visible wound bleeds along her forearm, blood smeared on her hands and the dragons' scales, hinting at a recent struggle or sacrifice to protect them. Her expression carries a mixture of exhaustion, grief, and fierce, unwavering maternal protectiveness.

**Scene 3 (20–28s):** A quieter, tender beat — inside a dim hidden nest made of piled hay and straw, the three baby dragons poke their heads out side by side in a neat row, their large reflective eyes blinking in the low light, ears/frills perked with alertness as if sensing an approaching threat. Shallow depth of field keeps focus tightly on their expressive faces, background falling into soft shadow.

**Scene 4 (28–38s):** Setting shifts to a dim, damp stone dungeon or underground cellar, pale light filtering through a small barred window high on the wall. The woman kneels low on the cold stone floor, her fur cloak draped protectively over her shoulders and partially covering the three dragons huddled behind and beneath her. She glances anxiously toward the doorway, body angled to shield the creatures from view, every muscle tense with the instinct to protect at any cost.

**Scene 5 (38–45s):** Intimate close-up — she gently cradles the pink baby dragon in both arms, rocking it slightly to keep it calm and quiet as its small mouth opens in a near-silent chirp or whimper. Her face is soft with tenderness toward the creature but tight with fear of discovery, eyes darting toward unseen danger beyond the frame.

**Scene 6 (45–55s):** Hard cut to a shadowy stone corridor elsewhere in the same fortress/castle. A stern, heavyset older man dressed in dark, heavy medieval robes strides purposefully down the corridor, a large lit torch held firmly in one hand, flames casting flickering, dangerous light across ancient carved stone walls. His expression is grim, suspicious, and resolute as he approaches a heavy iron-banded wooden door — the entrance to the dungeon where the woman and dragons are hiding. Low-angle, slightly ominous camera framing builds mounting dread and tension, the gap between pursuer and protector closing with every step.

**Overall tone and continuity:** A visceral, high-stakes escalation of the established dark-fantasy saga — shifting from tender nurturing (birth, feeding, warmth) toward active danger and sacrifice, as the same woman now harbors not one but three dragon hatchlings and must risk everything to keep them hidden from a clearly hostile authority figure. Visual and character continuity fully maintained: same actress/character design, same practical-effect creature rendering (wet-look skin on younger dragons, fine scale and frill texture, anatomically grounded proportions), same desaturated cold-exterior/warm-interior lighting philosophy established in prior installments. Sound design implied: distant echoing footsteps, crackling torch flame, soft dragon chirps, the woman's held breath. Aspect ratio 16:9, prestige-drama cinematography, emotionally driven pacing building toward confrontation.

0:00 – 0:05
Ember lifts the camera, smiles softly at the lens with his ears perking up, and says in a warm, slightly raspy voice:

0:05 – 0:13

text:
Long / Detailed Prompt:**

A warm, intimate scene continuing a dark-fantasy medieval drama, shot inside a rustic stone cottage interior with a prestige-television cinematic aesthetic — soft natural window light mixed with warm firelight, shallow depth of field, photorealistic creature texture work, handheld yet controlled camera movement, 16:9 widescreen, 24fps film grain, muted earthy color palette with warm amber accents.

**Scene 1 (0–6s):** Extreme close-up, low-angle shot on a rough-hewn wooden tabletop inside a dimly lit stone cottage. A small baby dragon — pale translucent pink skin, delicate frilled wing-like fins flaring from its head down its spine, large glossy dark eyes, soft rounded snout, and tiny sharp claws — crouches low on the table, sniffing curiously at a single gleaming gold coin resting in front of it. Faint dust motes drift through a shaft of soft light. Background softly blurred: a clay jug, a wooden bowl, and stone wall textures. The creature's skin has a faint wet sheen and subtle veining, anatomically detailed and grounded rather than cartoonish.

**Scene 2 (6–12s):** Wider shot reveals a young woman with long, dark, loosely tousled hair, wearing a cream lace-trimmed chemise beneath a dark woolen cloak, leaning across the wooden table toward the dragon. Her expression is tender, watchful, and slightly anxious — the look of someone hiding a secret and caring for it in private. A stone fireplace crackles warmly in the background, casting flickering amber light across the room, with a wrought-iron fire tool and hanging lantern visible nearby. A small leaded-glass window lets in cool grey daylight from the left, creating a natural contrast between warm interior firelight and cool exterior light.

**Scene 3 (12–20s):** The woman holds up a small torn piece of meat or bread between her fingers, offering it to the dragon. The baby dragon's eyes light up with eager attention; it opens its mouth to reveal small sharp teeth, its delicate wing-fins fluttering slightly with excitement, front claws gripping the wooden table as it leans forward to reach the food. Close-up alternating shots capture the dragon's playful, almost puppy-like eagerness and the woman's warm, affectionate half-smile as she watches it, clearly growing emotionally attached despite the danger of what the creature represents.

**Scene 4 (20–25s):** A final tender close-up — the dragon playfully snaps at the food, wings spreading slightly in excitement, while the woman smiles softly, her eyes reflecting the warm firelight. The mood is quiet, domestic, and secretly joyful, a brief moment of peace and bonding hidden away from the dangers of the outside world established in the earlier birth scene.

**Overall tone and continuity:** This is a direct continuation of the cave-birth dark-fantasy story — the same woman now secretly raising the dragon hatchling in hiding inside a humble medieval cottage, their bond deepening through small domestic moments like feeding. Visual continuity maintained: same character designs, same practical-effect creature texture (wet, fleshy, finely scaled, non-cartoonish), same muted cold-vs-warm cinematic color grading. Emotional core: forbidden maternal tenderness and quiet domestic intimacy contrasted against the creature's mythic, dangerous nature. Sound design implied: crackling fire, soft creature chirps/snorts, quiet ambient room tone. Aspect ratio 16:9, cinematic film grain, award-drama quality lighting and composition.

author: @AIwithkhan
text:
A girl enters a small late-night medical drug store holding a prescription, tired and slightly anxious; realistic Korean horror, narrow aisles filled with medicine boxes, glass cabinets, cold fluorescent lighting, quiet empty atmosphere.
She approaches the counter and asks the pharmacist for her medicine while he searches the shelves.
Her fingers freeze around the prescription; repeated scanner beeps echo through the silent store as the fluorescent lights begin flickering.
She suddenly stares toward the medicine aisle, sensing something behind her.
Her fingers begin twitching uncontrollably, slowly curling into unnatural positions.
She violently convulses against the counter; the pharmacist stumbles backward as medicine bottles fall from the shelves.
She collapses behind the counter, one arm twitching at an unnatural angle, her limbs becoming rigid and distorted.
She slowly rises again with wide unfocused eyes, a slack face, bent joints, and unnaturally twisted limbs.
Her head tilts at a broken angle as she stares directly at the pharmacist without blinking.
The pharmacist backs away in terror as her arms suddenly bend backward at the elbows.
Her jaw stretches impossibly wide, revealing an unnatural scream that echoes through the pharmacy.
She suddenly lunges forward over the counter with explosive speed, forcing the pharmacist to run.
She vaults over the counter with backward-bending limbs, moving unnaturally fast between the narrow aisles.
She stands completely still between the medicine shelves, wide unfocused eyes staring toward the entrance.
A customer enters and freezes when she slowly turns her head toward them.
Her fingers twitch as her bent joints and distorted limbs begin moving again.
She suddenly lunges down the aisle, knocking medicine boxes and bottles from the shelves.
The customer runs toward the exit and trips over a fallen basket.
The pharmacist grabs a fire extinguisher and pulls the pin with shaking hands.
White powder blasts into her face; she recoils into a glass medicine cabinet, her limbs folding at unnatural angles.
She slowly rises from the cloud, powder covering her face, wide unfocused eyes locked on the pharmacist.
Her jaw drops and stretches impossibly wide again as she suddenly lunges toward him.
He sprays the extinguisher continuously while backing toward the entrance.
She crashes through the glass door, her bent limbs twisting unnaturally as shards scatter across the empty nighttime street.
The pharmacist and customer stare through the shattered doorway in silence.
Final CCTV angle from inside the medical store; empty aisles, flickering lights, scattered medicine boxes.
A single medicine box slowly falls from a shelf. Cut to black.

text:
Create a 30-second, photorealistic live-action miniature-person VFX comedy video showing an ordinary shower turning into an extreme survival adventure. Use cinematic macro photography, ultra-shallow depth of field, realistic water physics, dynamic handheld camera movements, dramatic lighting, and spectacular scale contrast. The video should feel like a premium Hollywood miniature-action sequence filmed inside a real bathroom, with hilarious near-disasters and visually satisfying moments. Ultra-detailed 4K quality, realistic textures, natural motion blur, and physically believable interactions.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY

The main character is a tiny adult woman approximately 1:5 human scale, with realistic facial features, expressive eyes, shoulder-length dark hair tied in a small ponytail, a pastel-blue sleeveless top, dark shorts, and tiny white sneakers. Keep her face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and scale perfectly consistent throughout the entire video. She must look like a real miniature person, not an animated or cartoon character.

SCENE SEQUENCE

Scene 1 — The Danger Begins
A tiny woman stands on the edge of a bathroom floor beside a giant shower area, confidently preparing for a shower. The camera slowly pushes in as she looks up at the enormous showerhead above her. Suddenly, the shower turns on, and her confident expression changes to pure terror.

Scene 2 — The First Waterfall
A massive stream of water crashes down like a powerful waterfall. She runs for cover as giant droplets explode against the tiles around her. One enormous droplet splashes beside her, sending her tumbling backward across the wet floor.

Scene 3 — Soap Bar Avalanche
She climbs onto a giant soap bar to escape the rushing water. The slippery soap suddenly slides across the floor like a runaway skateboard. She desperately balances on top, waving her arms while racing toward the drain.

Scene 4 — The Shampoo Bottle Collapse
She jumps off the soap bar and grabs the edge of a giant shampoo bottle for safety. The bottle wobbles, tips over, and releases a thick stream of shampoo onto the floor. She slides down the slippery shampoo trail like a water slide, barely avoiding a giant puddle.

Scene 5 — The Drain Escape
The water begins flowing rapidly toward the bathroom drain. She runs in the opposite direction as tiny waves chase her feet. At the last moment, she leaps onto a raised tile edge and grabs a small grout line, dangling dramatically above the rushing water.

Scene 6 — The Final Victory
She pulls herself onto a dry bathmat, exhausted but triumphant. Behind her, the shower suddenly releases one final giant splash that sends her flying forward onto the soft mat. She slowly lifts her head, gives the showerhead an angry look, and shakes her fist at it. End with a dramatic close-up of her soaked, furious face.

CAMERA AND VISUAL STYLE

- Cinematic macro close-ups emphasizing the tiny woman's scale against oversized bathroom objects.
- Low-angle tracking shots following her frantic escape.
- Fast whip pans, subtle handheld shake, and brief slow motion during major splashes and jumps.
- Realistic water droplets, splashes, wet surfaces, reflections, and slippery soap physics.
- Sharp focus on the character with beautiful background bokeh.
- Comedic timing, expressive facial reactions, and seamless transitions between action beats.
- Maintain consistent bathroom layout, lighting, character appearance, and object positions.

SOUND DESIGN

Use synchronized, exaggerated but realistic sound effects: shower valve click, thunderous rushing water, heavy splashes, slippery soap squeaks, shampoo bottle thud, wet sliding sounds, frantic footsteps, dramatic whooshes, and a final soft bathmat landing. Add playful, suspenseful instrumental background music that builds during the chase and ends with a funny musical sting.

text:
Watch Venice become a sphere

Seedance 2.5 on @FishCreativeHQ 

Prompt

[Image 1](image_1) is the face and identity reference. A young Korean woman in her early twenties with EXACTLY the face of @[Image 1](image_1) — same facial structure, same features, natural Korean skin, no glasses. Long pastel pink hair, wearing a 1940s teal-orange wool coat-dress with white collar, a brown leather satchel worn cross-body, grey knee socks, black leather shoes, holding a folded yellow envelope. Every shot of her matches @[Image 1](image_1).
1940s Venice at golden hour. Amber and teal cinematic grade, anamorphic 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, volumetric god rays, fine film grain. Inception-style folding architecture — the Venetian city curls upward and hangs inverted overhead like a mirrored ceiling. The woman always stays under normal gravity while the world folds around her. Continuous camera motion, no hard cuts.
[TIMELINE PROMPT]
0–3s: Lateral tracking shot along a stone quay by the Grand Canal at sunset. The young woman @[Image 1](image_1) in a teal coat sprints past camera, clutching a yellow envelope. Above her the entire city hangs upside down, mirrored — a man in a bowler hat walks a dachshund across the inverted street. A red umbrella drifts weightlessly between the two worlds. Pigeons scatter through the amber light.
3–6s: Camera follows behind her into a narrow Venetian alley, dry leaves swirling in her wake. At the far end the street peels upward into the sky, buildings stacking vertically like a wall of windows. Her footsteps echo between the stone walls.
6–9s: The camera slowly rolls 90 degrees. The alley wall becomes the ground beneath her feet; she keeps running, unfazed. The roll continues into a wide orbit as she races up a floating spiral stone staircase suspended in mid-air, fragments of terracotta Venetian rooftops rotating around her like a kaleidoscope.
9–12s: Extreme wide silhouette. She runs across the top of an arched stone bridge over a wide canal against the blazing setting sun. The mirrored city hangs both above and below the arch. On the inverted plane, a lone pedestrian walks the opposite direction. Birds burst across the frame in slow motion.
12–15s: Low angle looking straight up between two towering building walls, the sky a thin bright strip. She leaps across the vertical chasm, arms spread wide, coat and hair flying, satchel swinging. Camera holds on her against the sky. Wind roars.
15–18s: Handheld push-in through a crowded 1940s Rialto market street — vendors stacking crates of apples, laundry strung overhead between the buildings. She weaves between blurred foreground shoppers, running away from camera. An apple rolls loose across the cobblestones.
18–21s: Camera tilts up a grand brick bell tower — a Venetian campanile — as the surrounding city folds and curls around it. The woman appears tiny on the tower ledge, pauses against the sun, then steps off toward the rooftops. Bells begin to ring.
21–24s: Rooftop terrace garden framed by a rose-covered arbor. An elderly woman in a grey cardigan waters a bed of vivid flowers with a tin can. Behind her, Venice and the domes of St Mark's Basilica glow at sunset over the lagoon while the inverted city hangs overhead. The young woman balances along the stone balustrade, arms out, then jumps down onto the terrace.
24–27s: She holds out the yellow envelope. The old woman turns, sets down the watering can, and takes it. Both smile warmly at each other. Rose petals drift upward past them, falling toward the inverted sky.
27–30s: Camera pulls back and rises fast. The whole city folds and rotates until it becomes a top-down aerial of Venice's canals and streets curling into a sphere. The two tiny figures remain on the terrace. Slow fade to warm light.

DO NOT reproduce their reference poses. DO NOT show any character standing flat-frontal with arms hanging limp at the sides. DO NOT reproduce the isolated cream/white empty backdrop from the character references — every character stands inside the game UI on the reflective floor. DO NOT place loose crystals, rubble blocks, or scattered debris props on the floor. Poses are dictated by the storyboard below."
style: "Stylized AAA game menu render. Faceted low-poly painterly hero models, Arcane-adjacent gouache shading, clean flat-white UI chrome. Crisp 4K."

Flanking cards are smaller, semi-transparent, and clipped at frame edge. Active card shows character portrait, NAME in bold black caps, class subtitle, and four stat rows: ARMOR / MOBILITY / HEALTH / POWER with colored values."

He rises to a tall three-quarter stance, tabard settling, shards still hanging suspended around him."

    sfx: "Card shuttle click-clack. Crystalline chimes. A single deep resonant thud on the fist plant."
  12_16_pyre:
    camera: "Slow subtle arc to the right around the character stage."
    action: "The card row shuttles left. The PYRE card centers, stats resolving to ARMOR HIGH, MOBILITY HIGH, HEALTH MED, POWER HIGH. PYRE drops to one knee and slams a palm flat to the floor — a column of orange flame erupts upward from the spider emblem burning through his chest plate. He sweeps his forearm in a wide burning arc, the fire trailing behind it in a smeared painterly ribbon, then rises into a bladed side-on guard, one fist cocked at the hip, flame guttering low at his helm crest."
    lighting: "Warm orange firelight washes his lilac plates and throws a moving glow across the floor."
    vfx: "Flame renders as stylized flat-shaped fire, not volumetric smoke."
    sfx: "Card shuttle click-clack. A muted whoosh on the eruption. Low ember crackle underneath."
  16_20_shard:
    camera: "Slow, controlled pull-back to frame the full interface. Hold."
    action: "The card row shuttles one final step left. The SHARD card centers, stats resolving to ARMOR MED, MOBILITY HIGH, HEALTH MED, POWER MAX. SHARD's body scatters into a burst of pale crystalline fragments and reassembles a full step to the right, landing low with two fingertips touching the floor. Violet particle flame pours off his dissolved left arm and drifts upward. He rises slowly, half-turns his masked head toward the lens, and holds — fragments still peeling off his shoulders and evaporating. The SELECT button pulses teal once. Hold on the frame."
    lighting: "Cool white key. Violet particle glow underlights his chest emblem and mask lenses."
    vfx: "Dissolve reads as flat painted shard shapes drifting off the silhouette, not smoke or embers."
    sfx: "Card shuttle click-clack. A soft glass-scatter sweep on the teleport. One clean UI chime on the SELECT pulse."

production_notes:
  audio_design: "Continuous low-tempo electronic menu loop underneath — soft synth pad, sparse pulse, no drums. Every card swap carries a short mechanical shuttle click-clack, like a rolling detent. Character sound effects stay restrained and diegetic: no impact booms, no orchestral hits, no risers. Music never swells; it holds one steady bed for all 20 seconds."

Character reference images supply design ONLY — no character is ever shown in the flat frontal arms-down reference pose, and no reference-image background props, crystals, rubble, or empty cream backdrop appear on the stage."

text:
Cinematic dark fantasy wuxia action scene, low angle dynamic tracking shot. A male warrior in black martial robes and arm guards stands in a tall grass field under an overcast gray sky. He spins dynamically, slashing a glowing fiery sword that leaves arc trails of bright orange fire and sparks. A massive swarm of black shadow beasts charges across the field. text:
SCENE CONTEXT
POV river-to-campfire sequence at a jade-green alpine river through birch/cedar forest, late-afternoon light. A trout is caught, cleaned, seasoned, grilled over an open fire, then eaten, with one sip from a glass bottle while it cooks. 30s, four continuous segments, three hard cuts, real chest-mounted action camera.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@location1: jade-green river, granite boulders, gravel bar, stone fire-ring, tree-stump table, birch/cedar tree line, faint peaks. 100% matches reference.
@hands1: sun-tanned forearms, light-blond arm hair, olive sleeve rolled to elbow, braided wrist cord. Same fly rod, folding knife, wood board, wire grill basket, plain glass bottle, brown fizzy liquid, no label. 100% matches reference.

LOCATION MAP
Segment A: river foreground, tree line behind. Segments B-D: gravel bar foreground, fire-ring and stump table midground, tree line and peaks background. POV chest-to-eye height, moving only with the body. Key light low, behind camera-left.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Non-empty opening frame: already mid-cast, rod raised, line already peeling off the reel. Water fills the lower two-thirds, forest/sky the top third.

FORMAT MODE
Controlled multi-shot, three HARD CUTs, camera does not cut anywhere else:
A (0-9s) river, one continuous take. HARD CUT.
B (9-21s) board, one continuous take. HARD CUT.
C (21-27s) fire, one continuous take. HARD CUT.
D (27-30s) eating, one continuous take.

OPTICS
84° in A easing to 63° through the fight. 63° easing to 18° across B. 63° opening to 29° in C. 29° held in D. No drift within any segment.

CAMERA
Chest-height POV, moving only with body motion — forward stroke on the cast, downward tilt on the knife and grate, forward lean when hands work close. Soft highlight roll-off on bright water and hot metal.

ACTION
A: rod arcs, line whistles; tip snaps down as the trout strikes; rod pumps, reel clicking, fish surfacing closer each pump; hand closes behind the gills, lifts the fish clear, holds it still one beat as water streams off. B: boots cross the gravel, fish set on the board, knife meets scales, scrapes tail to head; one clean line opens the belly, organs lift free; fish rinses in the shallows, pink cloud drifting off; salt, pepper, herbs scatter over the flesh; fish folds into the basket, latch clacks. C: kindling catches from a breath, flame licks up; basket lowers onto the grate, skin bubbles and browns, smoke lifts. D: bottle tips up for one swallow; fork pauses a half-second at the flesh before splitting it open, steam lifting as a piece rises toward camera, one quiet exhale closing the shot.

PERFORMANCE
Hands stay continuously busy with real working tasks, never idle. Pore-level realism: vellus arm hair in the breeze, capillary flush from cold water. Movements read practiced, unhurried, one deliberate pause at the fish-lift and one at the first bite, restrained and human, never cartoonish.

PHYSICS
No floating props. Correct contact shadows under every prop, every segment. Water carries real weight and splash. Fire holds true flicker, heat-shimmer, smoke on a light breeze. Mass and inertia carry through the rod bend, the fish's thrashing and the latch.

LIGHTING
WB locked 5600K, warm low sun behind camera-left as key, cool sky fill through A-B. From C onward, ember-orange fire light adds a low rim on hands and fish alongside the same key.

COLOR GRADE
Cool jade-green river/forest in A, warm honey wood and pale gravel in B, ember-orange fire glow and seared skin in C-D. Color tied to source and surface, not a flat list.

AUDIO
Warm acoustic guitar bed under everything, mixed low, sitting quietly beneath the natural sound. Diegetic: river current and line-whistle opening A, splash and reel-drag through the fight; gravel footsteps opening B, knife-on-wood, one clean cut sound, rinse-splash, hinge-click closing it; twig-snap opening C, crackle into sizzle; glass clink and swallow opening D, fork scrape, steam hiss, one quiet chuckle closing the shot. No subtitles.

STYLE
8K photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Naturalistic master cinematography, fine film grain, true action-camera color science.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
Real-time throughout, no speed ramping, FOV holds exactly as stated per segment with no drift across any hard cut.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same hands, sleeve and wrist cord across all four segments. Same rod, knife, board, basket and bottle, no substitutions across any cut. Same river, gravel bar and fire-ring geometry held across every segment. Fish skin and flesh stay anatomically real. Eyes stay natural — no eye glow. Contact shadows read clearly every segment. No logos, no UI, no subtitles anywhere in frame.

摄影者仍站在屋顶护墙边。画面底部短暂出现摄影者的双脚，强化真实第一视角和高空距离。

主角从圆形装置中心高速升起，沿原来的垂直路线返回屋顶。摄影机从垂直向下持续向上抬起，跟随主角穿过城市楼宇之间的空间。

主角升空后收紧腰腹，双膝靠近胸口，双臂抱住小腿，形成紧凑团身，在空中完成连续快速翻腾。不要锁定具体翻转方向，以自然连续旋转为准。

主角接近屋顶高度时开始打开身体：松开双腿、抬起头寻找屋顶、双脚转向下方，双臂向两侧展开保持平衡。

00:08.20-00:09.40｜返回屋顶

主角高速接近镜头，从屋顶护墙外侧越回停机坪。双脚同时接触绿色地面，膝盖和髋部深度弯曲，以低位蹲姿吸收落地冲击。

落地必须具有明显重量：鞋底或脚掌接触、腿部压缩、身体下沉、轻微反弹恢复。不能站直着轻飘落地。

摄影者快速后退半步，避免主角撞上镜头，同时继续保持正面近景。

00:09.40-00:10.00｜真实庆祝

主角从蹲姿快速站起，兴奋地看向镜头，张口欢呼。屋顶朋友冲进画面，举着手机围过来，拍肩、挥拳、大声庆祝。

镜头因人群靠近产生轻微晃动，以真实手机自拍视频状态结束。

Environment:
高楼灯光、街道车辆和彩虹灯环保持空间位置稳定。下落和上升必须发生在同一条垂直路线，主角最后返回起跳的同一栋屋顶。

Camera:
24mm手机广角，一镜到底。开始为背后低位跟拍；跃下后变为越肩俯拍；回弹时由垂直俯拍连续抬升至仰拍；最后恢复平视近景。

Style:
真实夜间手机曝光，高楼具有准确透视和尺度。下落阶段风声增强，城市灯光形成自然运动拖影；主角返回屋顶时速度极快，但人体轮廓仍然清晰。

Constraints:

text:
【核心规则】

1.零延迟衔接：招式与招式之间零缓冲，一击未落、下一击已出，剑刃始终保持高频接触。
2.动作驱动场景转换（关键）：任何场景变化（柱身→地面→横梁→大殿）必须由人物的具体动作完成——例如"男主被震退撞向殿柱""女主借力从柱顶翻身跃下砸向地面""两人缠斗中撞穿一排烛台滚落台阶"——绝不允许镜头单独切换场景而人物动作不连续。
3.真实力量感：每一次剑刃相击都要有清晰的身体位移反馈——被格挡的一方手臂震退半步、脚下打滑、身体因冲击力扭转——不是"两人站定互砍"，而是每一下都带着真实的体重和冲力。
4.禁止空转镜头：任何时候镜头运动（推近、环绕、甩镜）必须跟随人物正在进行的具体肢体动作，禁止画面出现人物静止而镜头单独旋转/环绕的情况。
5.贴身险招库：全片穿插以下具体招式，且不重复：
•贴地躲闪：一方横扫斩来，另一方猛然后仰几乎贴地，剑锋堪堪掠过鼻尖，发丝被削断
•直刺反击：躲闪的同时反手直刺，剑尖笔直突刺而出
•旋身格挡：被直刺方原地急速旋身躲开，同时手腕翻转格挡下一击
•翻滚起身反击：被打退跌地的一方就地翻滚，借旋转之力直接刺出反击
•剑锋绞缠近身：两剑绞在一起后，双方近距离肩靠肩角力，忽然同时脱手推开重新拉开架势

【分镜控制 0:00–0:30，全程动作连续无跳切】

[0:00–0:02] 35mm广角，低角度地面轨道镜头，紧跟人物冲刺
女主与男主同时从大殿两端全速冲刺而来，在殿中央剑刃相击的瞬间发力对撞，冲击力震得两人各自后退半步、脚下地砖迸裂溅起碎屑——开场即是全力对撞，无任何铺垫。

[0:07–0:09] 85mm长焦跟拍，人物动作驱动的场景转换
男主被震开的力道带得撞向身后龙柱，借柱身反弹之力翻身跃起，脚踏盘龙浮雕垂直跑上柱身；女主紧接着一个爆发式起跳追上柱身，两人在柱身上剑刃相击两三招，剑刃擦过柱身留下灼痕。

[0:09–0:12] 长焦跟拍转俯冲镜头，人物从高处坠落带动场景切换
男主被逼到柱顶横梁边缘，女主一记重击将他震退坠落，男主借坠落之势在半空中翻身调整姿态，剑尖朝下如同俯冲攻击，重重落回大殿地面的同时挥剑横扫；女主几乎同时从柱身跃下正面接下这一击，两剑相撞火花四溅，双方手臂因冲击力明显震颤——此处完成从柱身到大殿地面的自然场景过渡，全程动作不中断。

[0:12–0:17] 50mm特写，镜头持续跟随人物肢体动作，无空镜转场
近战组2（决战前最密集回合）：女主连续三次变向斩击，速度一次比一次快——男主第一次侧身避开、第二次贴地躲过、第三次干脆矮身钻入她剑锋下方近身，反手横斩女主腰侧；女主凌空后翻堪堪躲开，落地瞬间衣摆被剑气削开一角；男主趁她落地瞬间欺身直刺，女主侧身堪堪避开剑尖擦过肩侧，衣料应声裂开，同时反手一记重击震得男主剑身发出金属哀鸣、虎口震裂似地后退两步。

[0:17–0:21] 超广角跟拍，两人剧烈缠斗中撞向环境
两人剑刃绞缠近身角力，忽然同时脱手震开各自后退，紧接着几乎同时再度暴起冲向对方——这一冲带倒了身旁一排烛台，烛火被撞灭又被剑气余波重新点燃，两人在倒地的烛台与四溅的烛油中继续近身缠斗，剑刃碰撞产生密集火花，地面积水被踏起层层水雾。

[0:21–0:26] 特写转全景交替，剪辑跟随攻防节奏（非空转镜头）
双方招式速度达到全片顶点：斩、刺、格挡、反击在两三秒内连续发生，每一次碰撞都有清晰的身体反馈——女主被震得踉跄半步随即反手补上一剑，男主格挡后手臂剧烈震颤仍强行反击；蓝绿剑气缠绕成螺旋光流，两人的呼吸声与兵刃声交织成密集的节奏感，全程无一帧人物静止。

[0:26–0:29] 超广角全景，剧烈镜头震动，跟随最终对撞
双方在剑锋交汇的瞬间同时使出全力一击，两股能量对撞爆发出席卷全殿的蓝绿交织光潮，冲击波将两人同时震飞后退数米，地砖与柱身被震裂，烛火大片熄灭，烟尘弥漫整个神殿，镜头剧烈震颤后画面渐趋失焦泛白。

【通用限制】

Never redesign faces. Never change costumes. Never replace the temple. Never introduce additional characters. No face drift. No costume drift. No environment drift. No duplicated people. No dialogue. No narration. No subtitles. No text. No watermark. 全程镜头必须跟随人物具体动作运动，禁止人物静止时镜头单独旋转或空转。

author: @ChillaiKalan__
text:
30-SECOND CINEMATIC SHORT
Create a 30-second cinematic sequence with the visual discipline of a major feature film. The world is entirely made from paper, cardboard, ink, and delicate handcrafted materials.
00:00–00:05 — THE FIRST FOLD
Begin with an extreme macro shot of a blank sheet of textured paper.
A single fold slowly forms across its surface.
Lens: 100mm macro
Camera: Completely static
Soft daylight moves across the paper as the fold continues.
Cut precisely as the paper reaches its final shape.
00:05–00:11 — THE CITY EMERGES
Transition into a 50mm shot.
The folded paper begins forming miniature streets and architectural structures.
Buildings rise naturally from the surface through carefully constructed paper folds.
The camera slowly tracks sideways.
Tiny windows catch the light.
Nothing feels computer-generated; every surface should have believable paper fibers, folds, shadows, and imperfections.
00:11–00:17 — THE REVEAL
Move into a 35mm shot.
The camera pulls backward.
The small arrangement is revealed as an enormous handcrafted paper city stretching across a large table.
Roads connect different districts.
Bridges cross miniature rivers.
Paper trees move gently from an unseen breeze.
00:17–00:23 — MORNING
Transition into a slow overhead crane shot.
Warm sunlight gradually spreads across the paper city.
Shadows from the buildings become longer and more defined.
Tiny paper windows begin reflecting the sunlight.
The camera continues rising, revealing the geometric relationship between the streets and buildings.
00:23–00:27 — THE DETAIL
Cut to an 85mm close-up.
Focus on a tiny paper clock mounted on one building.
The clock moves forward by one minute.
Rack focus from the clock to the miniature skyline behind it.
00:27–00:30 — FINAL IMAGE
Return to an extreme wide shot.
The entire paper city sits beneath a large studio window.
The morning light completely fills the miniature world.
Camera slowly pulls backward until the city becomes a small object within the larger room.
Fade to black.
CINEMATOGRAPHY
Large-format feature-film aesthetic.
100mm macro for texture.
85mm for detail.
50mm for natural perspective.
35mm for environmental shots.
Controlled dolly and crane movements.
Realistic depth of field.
Natural focus transitions.
Soft motion blur.
Subtle lens imperfections.
No artificial camera shake.
MATERIAL DIRECTION
Every surface must visibly behave like physical paper.
Visible paper fibers.
Natural folds.
Tiny imperfections.
Soft cardboard edges.
Realistic contact shadows.
Believable paper thickness.
Natural material deformation.
LIGHTING
Soft morning daylight.
Large window as the primary source.
Natural bounce light.
Gentle shadows.
Subtle warm highlights.
No artificial neon effects.
No excessive visual effects.
CONTINUITY
The same paper city throughout the entire sequence.
Buildings maintain identical shapes and positions.
Roads remain connected.
Paper materials remain consistent.
No random transformations.
No flickering.
No duplicated structures.
No sudden environmental changes.
DIRECTOR’S NOTE
Treat this as a miniature feature film, not a visual-effects demonstration.
The camera should discover the world gradually.
Start intimate.
Reveal scale.
Return to detail.
Finish wide.
The audience should feel that they are watching a real handcrafted world photographed with a cinema camera.
Photorealistic 4K • tactile materials • feature-film cinematography • sophisticated lighting • realistic miniature photography • cinematic depth • precise camera movement • seamless visual continuity.

text:
Shot 1 (0.0–1.2s): Character A, matching reference face/outfit, lies in an upper sleeper bunk, curtain half-drawn, feverish and sweating, eyes slowly opening in the dark, dim blue night-train lighting.

Shot 2 (1.2–2.2s): Close-up of her gripping the bunk edge, veins darkening beneath her skin, shallow unnatural breathing.

Shot 3 (2.2–3.3s): Her eyes cloud milky white as her head tilts stiffly toward the bunk edge, silent dread.

Shot 4 (3.3–4.3s): A dark blood drop falls from her lips onto the curtain below, extreme close-up, slow motion.

Shot 5 (4.3–5.3s): Sleeping passenger stirs as another blood drop lands on his forehead, dim cabin light.

Shot 6 (5.3–6.3s): Wide view of the stacked bunks; her silhouette slowly leans over the sleeping passenger below.

Shot 7 (6.3–7.5s): She silently drops onto the lower bunk, straddling him; curtain sways, her feral bloodshot eyes filling the frame.

Shot 8 (7.5–8.7s): She bites his neck; his eyes snap open in shock and pain, cinematic slow-motion impact.

Shot 9 (8.7–9.8s): Close-up of the wound as dark veins rapidly branch across his skin, blackening outward.

Shot 10 (9.8–10.8s): His body violently seizes, curtain thrashing, muffled choking, flickering cabin light.

Shot 11 (10.8–11.8s): His eyes turn milky white, jaw twitching, dark veins spreading across his face, guttural breathing.

Shot 12 (11.8–12.8s): He throws his head back in an inhuman scream, ripping the curtain open; sound echoes through the sleeper car.

Shot 13 (12.8–13.8s): A nearby passenger wakes and cautiously peeks from his bunk into the dim corridor.

Shot 14 (13.8–14.8s): The turned passenger lunges into the corridor and attacks him, sudden violent impact.

Shot 15 (14.8–15.8s): Chaos erupts; curtains rip open as passengers wake to screams, confusion, and frantic movement.

Shot 16 (15.8–16.8s): A bitten passenger convulses against the wall as dark veins spread rapidly; others retreat in panic.

Shot 17 (16.8–17.8s): He turns within seconds and lunges at nearby passengers, triggering a chain reaction.

Shot 18 (17.8–18.8s): Passengers scramble through the cramped corridor, knocking over luggage and tearing down curtains.

Shot 19 (18.8–19.8s): A conductor grabs a fire extinguisher, bracing himself against the approaching infected.

Shot 20 (19.8–21.0s): He blasts the infected with white extinguisher foam, filling the corridor as they recoil.

Shot 21 (21.0–22.5s): Survivors rush to the connecting door and slam it shut while infected hands claw through.

Shot 22 (22.5–24.0s): They barricade the door with luggage and a fold-down seat as infected pound from outside.

Shot 23 (24.0–25.5s): Close-up of the door window: infected faces press against the glass as cracks spread under flickering emergency light.

Shot 24 (25.5–27.0s): A survivor pulls two children close, shielding them against the far wall as pounding intensifies.

Shot 25 (27.0–28.5s): Wide shot of survivors huddled in the next car, red emergency lights pulsing as the sealed door violently shudders.

Shot 26 (28.5–30.0s): Exterior wide shot: the sleeper train races through the night, windows flickering with chaos inside, ending in quiet dread.

text:
16:9 widescreen, 30 seconds, Dola Continuous Engine.
STYLE LOCK: Inspired by classic late-1960s Irwin Allen television production "Land of the Giants". Authentic 1968 television aesthetic. Practical miniature sets. Optical compositing. Slight matte-line separation between actress and background. Rear-projection feel. Eastmancolor television colors: warm skin, saturated red and yellow, slightly cyan shadows. Soft image sharpness. Mild film grain. Analog broadcast texture. Vintage studio lighting: one hard key from upper left, warm fill from the right, no rim light. Camera: static wide shots and slow television zoom lens only. No handheld. No modern lens flare.
CHARACTER LOCK: @[Image 1](image_1)  is the only person. She remains identical in every frame:  1960s Korean mini dress  with [sleeve and neckline  classic 1960s makeup with winged liner and pale pink lips, white heels. Dress, hair, makeup and shoes never change .
SETTING LOCK: an enormous 1960s dining table seen from her scale; she is the size of a salt shaker. White tablecloth hanging from the edge to the floor in long vertical folds. On the tabletop from left to right: a tall glass of milk with condensation beads, a giant slice of chocolate layer cake with thick frosting and a single lit birthday candle, a large silver spoon and fork crossed beside it, a bowl of vanilla ice cream with one huge cherry on top, a folded white napkin. Warm wooden tabletop. Pale yellow wall in the background. Props are practical scale with slightly soft edges.
0–4 seconds:
Static wide from floor level. The tiny woman climbs the hanging tablecloth, gripping the folds with both hands, one heel finding a fold below her. The cloth sways slightly under her weight. She looks up toward the table edge.
4–7 seconds:
Slow zoom in as she pulls herself over the edge, kneels, then stands upright on the tabletop. Her eyes widen and her mouth opens, gaze drawn toward the flickering candle flame on the cake. Her hands stay half raised.
7–11 seconds:
Static wide from behind her at her eye level. The dessert spread stretches across the table like a city skyline: the cake slice looms like a frosted mountain, the candle flame taller than she is, the milk glass glowing like a white tower, the spoon lying across the foreground like a bridge.
11–15 seconds:
She walks toward the cake, heels tapping the tabletop. Thick ridges of frosting drip down its side. The lit candle flickers above, casting warm moving light across her face. She touches the frosting edge with one hand and looks up along the flame.
15–19 seconds:
She climbs onto the cake's bottom layer, sits, scoops a bit of frosting with both hands, smiles, tastes it, licks her fingers, and looks left and right. Medium shot, slow zoom in to her face, candlelight flickering warmly on her skin.
19–23 seconds:
She stands and walks farther across the tabletop, stepping around the giant cherry from the ice cream bowl, passing between the spoon and the napkin. Static wide, then a slow pan following her.
23–26 seconds:
She stops beside the milk glass, looks up along the tall glass, and laughs with one hand resting on it. Condensation beads glisten and catch the light on her face.
26–28 seconds:
A massive shadow sweeps across the tabletop from the right and covers the milk glass and the cake. Her laugh stops. She lowers her hand and turns to face the right side of frame.
28–30 seconds:
HOLD. Camera fully static medium-wide shot. She stands facing screen right, feet together, right hand half raised at chest height, left hand at her side. The milk glass directly at her left, the cake slice behind her, the shadow across the whole tabletop. Her face is turned to the right, not yet tilted upward. Nothing moves for two full seconds.
Audio
Cheerful 1960s adventure television music, playful brass and strings. At 26 seconds the music thins to one held string note that continues to the end, with a faint fading birthday-music-box

text:
Seedance 2.5 via @openart_ai made this farm day look way too real 😯

Prompt 

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary summer afternoon in the life of a young Korean woman visiting a small traditional farm and helping with the animals. No reference image.

A naturally pretty beautiful Korean woman in her early 20s, realistic natural skin texture, minimal makeup, relaxed and cheerful personality. Long black hair tied in a loose low ponytail. She wears a loose white cotton T-shirt, light olive-green cargo pants, brown ankle boots, and a beige canvas crossbody bag. Keep the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and overall appearance throughout the entire video.

A small traditional countryside farm outside Seoul during a warm summer afternoon. Wooden fences, green fields, an old farmhouse, barn, hay bales, vegetable patches, chickens, cows, buckets, farming tools, trees and natural countryside surroundings. The farm feels ordinary and lived-in, not like a tourist attraction.

The camera is ALWAYS positioned IN FRONT OF THE GIRL, never behind her. A friend stands or walks in front of her, casually filming her with a handheld consumer DV camcorder/smartphone. Her front face must remain clearly visible during the important moments. The camera naturally moves backward while she walks toward it. Use imperfect handheld movement, small shakes, slightly uneven framing, autofocus hunting, occasional exposure changes, natural motion blur, soft digital detail, mild image noise, faded early-2000s home-video colors, and occasional accidental zooms.

Absolutely NO rear-view shots, NO filming from behind, NO drone, NO gimbal, NO cinematic tracking shots, NO polished commercial look, NO beauty filter. It should genuinely feel like a friend casually recorded this afternoon.

TIMELINE

0:00–0:05 — Arriving at the Farm

The girl walks toward the farm entrance while the friend walks backward in front of her filming. She smiles naturally and looks around at the animals and fields. She says casually in Korean:

“오늘 농장에 왔어요.”

Natural footsteps, birds, insects and distant farm sounds.

0:05–0:10 — Feeding the Cow

Still filmed from the front, the girl approaches a calm cow and holds out fresh vegetables. The cow gently eats from her hand. She laughs naturally and looks at the camera, then back at the cow.

0:10–0:15 — Helping With Vegetables

Hard cut. The camera remains in front of her as she walks through a vegetable patch and picks fresh vegetables. She holds them up toward the camera with a happy smile.

0:15–0:20 — Chickens

Hard cut. Several chickens suddenly walk across the path in front of her. The camera stays facing her from the front as she laughs and carefully steps around them. One chicken comes close to her boots.

0:20–0:25 — Farmhouse Break

She sits outside the farmhouse with a basket of freshly picked vegetables and eats a piece of fresh fruit. She looks relaxed and slightly tired from working. She smiles at the camera and says:

“생각보다 재밌어요.”

0:25–0:30 — Walking Away / Goodbye
She gets up and walks toward the camera, then stops near the farm entrance. The friend keeps filming from directly in front of her. She gives a small wave and says:

“다음에 또 올게요. 안녕!”

She walks past the camera as the recording ends naturally.

AUDIO:
Only authentic location sound: birds, chickens, cows, insects, footsteps, leaves, distant farm activity and natural conversation. No background music, no narration, no artificial sound effects.

FINAL LOOK:
Completely believable real-life home-video footage. Slightly imperfect, spontaneous, unpolished and human. Front-facing camera coverage throughout the story, with the girl's face clearly visible.

【00:07–00:11 — LOW WATER SPIN SWEEP / 超高速原地圆形扫腿】
这是第一反击，也是本片最重要动作之一。
两名仍在嘲笑PYONA的不良女生已经站到她近距离，一名位于正前偏左，一名位于正前偏右。第三名正在稍后位置靠近。两名近身敌人的脚踝与小腿必须明确处于PYONA真实扫腿范围内。

倒在地上的PYONA正脸或3/4正面脸 + 她撑地的一只手 + 准备伸直的扫腿 + 两名敌人的腿部位置。

她的双脚迅速失去稳定，身体被强力掀离原来的直立轴线，紧接着重重摔倒。

slide tackle,

forward body travel,

breakdance performance,
dance-like rotation,
careful sweep,
soft contact,
enemies falling before leg contact,

【00:11–00:15 — HYDRO STEP / 强攻第三人】

动作连续、快速、凶狠，无等待。

【00:15–00:18 — WATER GUARD / 硬接反击】

不是轻轻泼水。
必须像强力高压水流突然正面轰中。

PYONA立即向前压迫，不站着看结果。

【00:23–00:26 — RING WATER SHOCKWAVE / 环形水波震退】
剩余几名女生从不同方向同时重新逼近PYONA。

禁止生成静态水结界。
禁止透明球形护盾。

周围水分瞬间被拉向她脚下，随后：

以PYONA为中心，一圈强烈、透明、具有重量的环形水压波突然沿木地板和低位空间向四周爆炸式扩散。

不是防护罩。
这是向外猛烈释放的水压冲击。

正在逼近的敌人必须发生强烈物理反应：

一人重心被掀向后方；
一人与侧面的同伴猛烈撞在一起；
另一人脚下打滑、膝盖几乎着地。

领头者没有完全倒下。她强行顶住第一波冲击，调整脚步后继续正面扑向PYONA。

这自然建立最终1对1攻击线。
【00:26–00:30 — HYDRAULIC PALM / 最终高潮】
领头者强行冲过残余水流，正面高速接近并挥出强力拳击。

PYONA不从远距离发射魔法。

她主动向前踏入真正攻击距离，身体偏转，让领头者拳头从脸侧擦过。

同时右手周围水分高速压缩。
PYONA右掌必须先真实、重重地撞入领头者上身中央。

先看见：

WATER COMPRESSION
→ dense cavitation bubbles
→ HYDRAULIC COLLAPSE.

HYDRAULIC PALM爆发。
强烈透明水压从实际掌部接触点瞬间向前爆开。领头者整个上身被猛烈震退，双脚失去稳定，在体育馆木地板上高速向后滑出，大片水雾和碎裂水滴向外爆散，沉重冲击声在体育馆内形成强烈回音。
最后一名敌人立刻从侧后方扑向PYONA，不给她休息。

另一只手掌重重按中对方肩胸线。
SHORT HYDRAULIC PRESSURE PALM.
短距离水压再次从接触点爆开，对方立即被推倒并沿木地板滑出。
PYONA不庆祝、不欣赏水、不摆英雄Pose。
她仍然急促喘息，浅粉蓝短发明显因战斗变得稍微凌乱，脸侧和image1中的服装表面残留真实水滴。
她立即转身保持战斗姿态，快速扫描体育馆。

CUT WHILE TENSION IS STILL ACTIVE.
【TARGET LOCK】
所有攻击必须先存在明确目标和正确距离：

【摄影】
第一镜头必须正面或3/4正面看清PYONA的脸和5人包围关系，禁止背影开场。
PYONA倒地后摄影机立刻降低到接近木地板的高度，同时捕捉她的疼痛表情、周围女生嘲笑和敌人的腿部位置。

LOW WATER SPIN SWEEP这一个动作的摄影机不要高速绕着PYONA旋转，也不要跟着她向前移动。使用低机位、稍宽的侧前方视角，在PYONA扫腿核心动作的0.8–1.0秒内保持稳定清晰，让同一画面能够读到：
PYONA固定撑地手 + 低位髋部旋转 + 伸直扫腿 + 第一名敌人腿部被命中 + 第二名敌人随后被扫中。

WATER GUARD中近景拍清拳头撞入水膜。
FACE WATER CANNON必须看见水从PYONA掌前直接轰中敌人脸部。

最后HYDRAULIC PALM进入强烈中近景，优先展示身体接触、衣料压缩、水压爆发和敌人反应。
ACTION READABILITY > PHYSICAL IMPACT > WATER POWER > CAMERA CHAOS.
【绝对禁止】
禁止第一镜头只拍PYONA背影。
禁止重新觉醒。
禁止PYONA研究自己的水能力。
禁止开场未完整摔倒就反击。
禁止LOW WATER SPIN SWEEP变成：
slow slide、
slide tackle、
forward crawl、
forward travel、
slow spin、
breakdance、
dance move、
slow-motion spinning attack。
禁止PYONA在扫腿时向敌人方向滑过去。
禁止PYONA身体中心在扫腿过程中明显向前移动。
禁止轻轻碰腿后敌人才慢慢倒下。
禁止敌人在没有明确腿部接触的情况下自动摔倒。
禁止PYONA轻轻挥手后敌人自动摔倒。
禁止任何谨慎、轻柔、慢吞吞的格斗。
禁止敌人排队。
禁止敌人受击后没有明显身体反应。
禁止18秒站着长时间聚水。
禁止FACE WATER CANNON像轻柔喷水。
禁止23秒生成静态水结界或保护罩。
禁止巨大海啸、水龙、魔法阵、激光、能量球、瞬移。
禁止攻击篮球架、器材或空气。
禁止游戏CG人物、廉价动漫特效、AI塑料皮肤。
禁止英雄Pose收尾。
核心目标：
开场必须清楚看见PYONA的脸。她被正面重拳击中腹部后真实、完整地摔倒，并被周围女生大声嘲笑。
第一反击必须严格表现为原地低位圆形扫腿，而不是任何形式的滑行或冲刺。
PYONA仍然倒在原来的位置，一只手牢牢撑地，以该支撑点和低位髋部为轴，一条腿完全伸直，在约0.8–1.0秒内完成爆发式高速圆形横扫。她的身体中心基本保持原位，真正移动的是高速旋转的腿。腿先真实扫中第一名敌人的脚踝/小腿，使其支撑腿瞬间失效并重重摔倒；同一次旋转立即继续扫中第二名敌人，使其同样失去下盘并重摔。
水只能贴着PYONA真实扫腿轨迹增强速度、冲击和横向力量，绝不能代替腿部接触自动把人打倒。
除此之外，后续动作保持原有结构不变：
Hydro Step高速突进 → Water Guard硬接攻击 → Face Water Cannon正面强力轰击 → Ring Water Shockwave把多人向外猛烈震退 → Hydraulic Palm以真实掌部接触结合极高水压完成高潮。

整场动作必须强硬、快速、危险、毫不克制，绝不能呈现谨慎、温柔或慢吞吞的动作感觉。

text:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic Korean zombie survival thriller, cinematic live-action style.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: Young adult Korean woman, identical face, hairstyle, outfit, and body proportions to the reference image throughout. Expression evolves from terrified to desperate, determined, then shaken relief.

ZOMBIES: Aggressive, realistic human-like zombies with pale dirty skin, sunken eyes, damaged faces, messy hair, and torn everyday clothing. Practical horror makeup, no excessive gore.

LOCATION: One consistent dim Korean apartment tower: concrete stairwell, narrow numbered-door corridor, flickering greenish fluorescent lights, metal elevator with glowing floor indicator, CLOSE DOOR button, and pulsing red emergency light.

30-SECOND SEQUENCE (10 SHOTS):

1. 0–3s: Close-up, woman sprints down stairs as zombie hands reach from above.
2. 3–6s: She bursts into corridor, shoves an attacking zombie into the wall.
3. 6–9s: Rear tracking shot as she races toward the elevator, zombies emerging behind her.
4. 9–12s: She repeatedly presses elevator call button; horde approaches.
5. 12–15s: Doors open; she dives inside as zombies charge.
6. 15–18s: Extreme close-up, repeatedly jams CLOSE DOOR button as doors begin shutting.
7. 18–21s: Zombie arms force through the gap; she kicks them away.
8. 21–24s: Doors slam shut; she trembles as zombies pound outside.
9. 24–27s: Elevator descends; she collapses against the wall, gasping.
10. 27–30s: Lobby doors open, revealing motionless shadowy figures. One slowly turns its head. Extreme close-up of her terrified eyes. CUT TO BLACK.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: Handheld chase tracking, dynamic wide shots, extreme close-ups, low-angle elevator struggle, realistic movement, natural motion blur, cinematic green-gray lighting, practical VFX, consistent spatial continuity.

AUDIO: Heavy breathing, rapid footsteps, zombie snarls, fluorescent buzz, elevator chime, metallic scraping, pounding doors, elevator hum, rising horror drone. No narration.

NEGATIVE: No location changes, rooftop, outdoor scenes, phones, weapons, superhero powers, fantasy effects, extra limbs, duplicated heroine, identity or outfit changes, cartoon/anime, excessive gore, subtitles, random text, or watermark.

OUTPUT: One coherent, suspenseful, photorealistic 30-second Korean zombie-thriller sequence with seamless character and environment consistency.

text:
SCENE — WATERBENDING AMBUSH
DURATION: exactly 10 seconds
FORMAT: 16:9
STYLE: ultra-photorealistic live-action fantasy action, grounded CGI, realistic water physics, Hollywood stunt choreography, practical jungle-temple location, handheld cinematography, seamless VFX integration, no digital-art appearance.
PACE: extremely fast continuous combat, zero pauses, zero idle moments, action already in progress.

REFERENCES

IMAGE 1 — ARMAN
Preserve facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, costume, and appearance exactly.

IMAGE 2 — MASTER ENVIRONMENT SHEET
Preserve environment, architecture, vegetation, atmosphere, and location identity exactly.

IMAGE 3 — ENEMY REFERENCE
Preserve enemy armor, silhouette, proportions, and visual identity exactly.

ACTION

0.0–2.5 SECONDS — SURROUNDED
Fight begins mid-combat. Five armored enemies attack from multiple directions. Arman pivots beneath a frontal strike while a large mass of water is already orbiting around him. He redirects the flow to deflect Enemy A. Several sections split from the moving water, instantly freeze into sharp ice shards, and fire toward attacking enemies. Camera performs fast handheld lateral tracking.

2.5–5.0 SECONDS — ROTATING PRESSURE
Enemy C closes from behind. Arman ducks beneath an attack and transitions into a continuous spinning movement. The main water mass whips around him with believable inertia, striking, deflecting, and creating openings. Multiple ice shards separate from the flowing water and launch toward different attackers, forcing evasions and interrupting attacks. Camera reacts with quick pans and target switching.

5.0–7.5 SECONDS — WATER IMPACT
Enemy A attacks again. Arman redirects the entire water mass into a powerful lateral strike. Water impact throws the enemy sideways onto wet stone. While the enemy falls, additional ice shards fire toward advancing attackers. Arman immediately turns toward the next threat without stopping.

7.5–10.0 SECONDS — COMBO CONTINUES
Enemies close from opposite directions. Arman performs rapid circular footwork while continuously controlling the moving water flow. Fresh ice shards split from the leading edge and fire toward multiple enemies. Enemy C charges directly into range. Arman pivots and accelerates the main water mass toward him.

END BEFORE IMPACT.

SMASH CUT. ACTION INTERRUPTED MID-COMBO. END.

VISUAL RULES

- Five active enemies remain engaged throughout.
- No enemy stands and watches.
- Combat never slows down.
- Water remains a single continuous moving mass.
- Ice shards separate from the moving water, instantly freeze, and launch as sharp translucent projectiles.
- No glowing effects, energy beams, neon trails, or anime aura.
- Grounded CGI integrated into live-action photography.
- Every action directly causes the next event.
- Continuous movement, zero pauses, zero dead frames.
- Final frame preserves active combat momentum for Scene 02.

CAMERA

Reactive handheld Hollywood action camera. Fast but readable movement, medium-wide coverage, brief wider shots for major impacts, natural motion blur, occasional water spray crossing lens. No floating virtual camera.

ENVIRONMENT

Ancient jungle temple ruins. Wet stone, moss, roots, ferns, waterfalls, dense tropical vegetation, humid atmosphere, realistic live-action location photography.

SOUND

Raw action only. Footsteps, armor movement, weapons cutting air, rushing water, splashes, ice projectiles, impact sounds, bodies hitting wet ground, distant waterfalls and jungle ambience.

NO MUSIC.

Shot 14 (16–17.3s): Passengers rise in panic, grabbing bags and backing away, wide cinematic shot.

Shot 17 (19.7–21s): He lunges at the nearest passenger; screams erupt as the car descends into chaos, handheld camera.

Shot 18 (21–22.5s): Passengers scramble over seats and luggage toward the exit, bags spilling everywhere.

Shot 19 (22.5–24s): A group rushes toward the connecting door, looking back as infection spreads behind them.

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-realistic personal home-video showing an ordinary evening in the life of a young Korean woman. No reference image.

MAIN SUBJECT

Young Korean woman same face as <<<image_1>>> in her early 20s, naturally pretty, realistic skin texture with visible pores and texture, minimal makeup, soft and slightly tired expression after a long day.

Long straight black hair tied in a loose low bun, a few flyaway strands near her ears, small silver hoop earrings.

Wearing an oversized beige knit cardigan over a plain black turtleneck, straight-leg dark jeans, white canvas sneakers, and carrying a small worn tote bag.

Maintain the same face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and appearance throughout the entire video.

SETTING

A quiet riverside neighborhood in Seoul on a cool early-autumn evening, right after a light rain has just stopped.

Wet pavement reflecting streetlights, a small laundromat with fogged windows, a street-side flower stand closing up, a covered bus shelter, a narrow pedestrian bridge over a stream, scattered puddles, string lights above a closed market alley, a convenience store with a lit sign, and a few pigeons picking at the ground. Everything damp, quiet, and softly lit as dusk settles in.

**CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC**

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend.

Handheld camera with natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional partial crops, autofocus hunting on reflections and wet surfaces, exposure shifts between streetlight glow and shadow, mild motion blur, soft image detail, subtle digital noise, slightly desaturated evening colors, and natural camera imperfections.

The camera operator walks with her and reacts naturally.

No stabilization, no cinematic camera movements, no dramatic lighting, no slow motion, no polished commercial appearance.

The footage should feel accidentally beautiful rather than deliberately cinematic.

---

**00:00–00:05 — LEAVING THE LAUNDROMAT**

She pushes open the laundromat door, stepping out with a small basket of folded laundry against her hip.

She glances up at the sky, checking if it's really stopped raining, and exhales a small relieved breath.

The camera follows her out, slightly unsteady on the wet step.

She glances back at the camera with a tired little smile.

**00:05–00:10 — THE FLOWER STAND**

She walks past a street-side flower stand that's closing up for the night.

She pauses, picks up a small bundle of daisies on impulse, pays the vendor, and tucks them into her tote bag.

The camera briefly focuses on the flowers before drifting back up to her face.

**00:10–00:15 — THE PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE**

She crosses a narrow footbridge over the stream, puddles reflecting the streetlights beneath her feet.

She stops halfway, resting her forearms on the railing, looking down at the water without saying anything.

The camera stays slightly shaky and imperfectly framed, as if her friend is just leaning on the railing beside her.

**00:15–00:20 — CONVENIENCE STORE STOP**

She ducks into a small convenience store, the automatic door chiming behind her.

She grabs a warm canned coffee from the heated shelf, pays, and steps back outside, cracking it open right away.

A passing scooter splashes through a puddle in the background.

The camera operator accidentally clips the doorframe while following her out, then quickly reframes.

**00:20–00:25 — BUS SHELTER**

She sits under a covered bus shelter, sipping her coffee, laundry basket beside her feet.

A few pigeons wander near the curb; she watches them idly, unbothered.

Steam rises faintly from the coffee can in the cool evening air.

The camera drifts slightly out of focus on the streetlight behind her, then refocuses.

**00:25–00:30 — FINAL MOMENT**

She notices the camera still recording and turns toward it, laundry basket now tucked under one arm.

She gives a small amused, slightly embarrassed smile and says:

*"Why are you still filming me?"*

She laughs quietly and starts walking toward the camera, waving it off with her free hand.

The camera moves backward as she approaches, and the recording abruptly cuts to black before she reaches it.

---

**AUDIO**

Natural location sound only:

Footsteps on wet pavement, distant traffic, dripping water, a scooter passing, the convenience store door chime, coins and paper bag rustling, pigeons cooing, fabric movement, a bus passing in the distance, and subtle handheld camera noise.

No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

Only the single spoken line: *"Why are you still filming me?"*

**FINAL FEEL**

The entire video should feel like a completely ordinary rainy evening that somehow became a quiet, beautiful memory.

Soft, feminine, tired-but-content, intimate, gently nostalgic, and unplanned.

No dramatic events. No exaggerated acting. No model poses. No cinematic hero shots.

The realism should come from tiny imperfections, damp reflections, casual body language, natural expressions, ordinary surroundings, imperfect camera operation, and moments that feel completely unposed.

SETTING

A quiet older Seoul residential neighborhood during a warm summer afternoon. Narrow concrete lanes, small houses, old walls, potted plants, parked bicycles, utility poles, overhead wires, laundry hanging outside homes, a small convenience store, and children playing football in the street.

Everything should feel lived-in, ordinary, and peaceful.

CAMERA / VISUAL AESTHETIC

Raw personal footage casually recorded by a friend on an early-2000s consumer DV camcorder.

Strong handheld shake, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure shifts, occasional motion blur, faded colors, soft digital detail, mild noise, accidental zooms, and natural camera imperfections.

No stabilization, drone footage, gimbal movement, dramatic lighting, or polished commercial cinematography.

— LEAVING HOME

She steps outside her house, closes the door, and adjusts her messy side ponytail.

A gentle summer breeze naturally moves her loose hair and a few strands fall across her face. She smiles at the camera, brushes the strands away, and starts walking down the narrow neighborhood lane.

— STOPPING AT THE STORE

She reaches a tiny neighborhood convenience store and walks inside.

She casually browses the shelves, picks up a colorful pack of bubble gum, and pays at the counter.

She turns the tap, cups her hands beneath the flowing water, and drinks a little.

She waves at them and continues walking.

She reaches the corner of the neighborhood and pauses.

She raises one hand, gives a casual wave, and says clearly:

author: @liyue_ai
text:
时长：20秒
画幅：9:16竖屏
风格：情侣POV手持手机实拍感（Boyfriend POV），夏日户外自然光，一镜到底、绝对无剪辑，真实手机随手记录质感。
角色：主角 

【人物参考锁定】
上传的图片 {{Mixed 1}} 是女主角唯一、完整的人物视觉参考。

从第一帧到最后一帧，严格保持参考图中的：

人物身份
脸部五官
脸型
肤色
年龄感
发型
发色
身高
体型
身体比例
服装
鞋履
整体人物气质。

不得自行改变或重新设计人物服装，不增加参考图中不存在的饰品。

正面、四分之三侧面、低头、抬头、说话、笑、走近镜头以及手部靠近面部时，始终保持同一张脸、同一个身体比例和同一套服装。

不要继承参考图的背景、构图、姿势、文字和原始光线。

【整体表演原则】

女主角不是在表演短剧，也不知道男友准备说情话。

她只是被男友临时叫住、随手拍摄。

所有反应必须像真实人在日常聊天中自然发生：

先听见
→ 短暂停顿并理解
→ 表情开始变化
→ 身体随后产生反应
→ 前一个表情留下少量余韵
→ 再进入下一个状态。

表情变化不能像切换表情包。

不要逐条、机械地控制眉毛、眼睛、鼻子和嘴。

面部可以出现轻微不对称、没有完全完成的笑、自然眨眼、短暂走神、吞咽、换气和视线回避。

她主要看向手机后面的男友，而不是始终精准盯住手机镜头。

台词之间保留真实的理解时间、呼吸和没有说话的小停顿。

害羞不依赖明显脸红表现。

不要生成突然出现的红色双颊、均匀腮红、粉色滤镜或夸张发热效果。

如果自然光和情绪使面部出现颜色变化，只允许非常轻微、缓慢、不均匀的肤色升温，也可以完全不出现明显红晕。

害羞主要通过：

视线短暂移开
嘴角压不住
说话速度变慢
手部短暂停顿
身体轻微侧开
不敢持续看男友

来表现。

【机位与景别原则】

男友手持手机，以第一人称视角拍摄女主角。

男友本人始终不进入画面，只保留近距离画外声音。

两人最初保持约1.8–2米的正常聊天距离。女主角走近时，男友自然后退半步，使最近距离仍保持约1.2–1.5米，不形成压迫式贴脸拍摄。

全片以全身和上半身景别为主。

绝不出现脸部填满画面的大特写。

起手：

全身中景，女主角完整出现在画面中，头顶、脚下地面和身后的树都清楚可见。

中段：

腰部以上的上半身景别，头顶持续保留明显空间。

最近处：

胸口以上的半身近景，头顶、颈部、双肩和部分胸口仍完整保留在画面内，上下左右都有余量。

景别变化只能由拍摄者和女主角的真实走动、轻微抬手和自然调整构图产生。

禁止数字变焦、突然推近、镜头跳位和任何隐形剪辑。

手机保持正常1×主摄视角，不使用超广角面部畸变，不使用长焦偷拍质感。

镜头全程带轻微手持微晃和拍摄者呼吸造成的小幅上下起伏。

男友说话或笑时，手机可以出现极轻微同步抖动。

跟随人物走近时允许出现一次短暂、轻微的自动对焦迟疑，随后自然恢复清晰。

不使用稳定器，不进行电影式运镜。

【环境】

夏日午后的树荫小路。

女主角站在斑驳树影里，身后是一排绿树和被阳光晒亮的路面。

使用真实手机景深。

由于人物与背景存在距离，远处树叶和路面可以自然稍微柔化，但不能形成夸张的奶油虚化、人工光斑或人像模式边缘错误。

树叶被微风吹动。

斑驳树影缓慢扫过地面和人物服装，偶尔轻轻经过脸部，但不能遮住主要表情。

保留真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、细小面部起伏和自然肤色差异。

全程无字幕、无滤镜、无美颜、无磨皮、无特效、无背景音乐。

——————

【00:00–00:04｜全身中景·突然被叫住】

这只是同一连续镜头的第一个表演阶段，不切镜。

起手保持全身中景。

女主角稍微侧背对镜头，站在树荫下，低头随手整理袖口或查看手里的小东西。

重心自然落在一条腿上，另一条腿放松。

她没有提前看镜头，也没有摆好拍照姿势。

画外男声距离很近，带少量真实手机麦克风质感，像临时起意一样随口说：

“诶，看这儿——笑一个。”

她听见声音后延迟半拍。

先轻轻“嗯？”一声，再抬起头，把视线从手里转到手机后面的男友。

她没有立刻露出夸张惊讶。

只是稍微停一下，像是在确认“现在拍吗”。

她想配合着笑，但这个笑不太自然：

嘴角只轻轻抬起一点，停留不到一秒。

眼神仍带着刚被叫住的迟疑，短暂看开一下，再回到男友方向。

下巴略微收紧。

手里整理袖口的动作停住，不知道是否应该摆姿势。

她保持这个勉强配合的浅笑，轻声问：

“……这样？”

语气不确定，尾音轻微上扬。

问完后嘴角自然松下来一些，不要突然完全变脸。

【00:04–00:07｜上半身·被说中旧事】

全程不切镜。

男友向前自然走一步，同时略微抬高手机。

画面从全身中景自然变成腰部以上的上半身景别，头顶保持充足余量。

画外男声带着忍笑的口吻说：

“跟你第一次见我妈那天一样。”

她先出现一个很短的理解停顿。

原本没有完全消失的浅笑仍留在嘴角。

眼神先停住，像是在回想这句话是什么意思。

随后她意识到男友在取笑自己。

她抬眼看向男友，身体向前靠小半步，语速自然变快：

“那能一样吗！我那是紧张！”

语气是熟人之间被揭旧事后的辩解，音量稍微提高，但不尖叫。

她可以下意识抬起一只手解释一下，动作做到一半又觉得没必要，顺势放下来。

表情以“有点急、又知道对方在逗自己”为主。

不要突然瞪大眼睛，不要强制脸颊变红，不要演成真正生气。

【00:07–00:10｜上半身·自己忍不住笑】

上一句说完后，她本来还想维持认真辩解的样子。

她先抿住嘴，努力不笑。

短暂停顿后，一点笑意从嘴角漏出来。

她从鼻子里轻轻笑出一声，随后才真正笑起来。

整个笑的程度保持日常、克制，不是夸张爆笑。

笑声可以带一点断续换气。

她稍微低头、肩膀跟着笑轻轻动两下。

一只手下意识抬到嘴边，但没有完全遮住脸。

她侧开一点视线，像是不想让男友看到自己已经绷不住。

停留片刻后，她重新看向男友，仍带着笑说：

“……你还提这个！”

台词有一点含混，因为笑意还没有完全退去。

说完，她伸手朝手机方向做一个很轻的虚拍动作。

手掌只从画面边缘经过，不覆盖整个镜头，也不真正碰撞手机。

男友本能地避让一下。

画面随之产生一次短促、幅度很小的自然晃动，随后重新回到她身上。

【00:10–00:12｜上半身·笑意慢慢停下】

全程保持同一镜头。

画外男声忽然把笑意收住，语气听起来像真的发现了什么：

“诶，别动，你嘴角有东西。”

她的笑意不能瞬间消失。

她先停住正在说话的动作。

残留的笑声变成一小口呼气。

抬在嘴边的手慢慢放低。

眼神从放松变成疑惑。

她看着手机后面的男友，停顿一下，像是在判断他是不是又在开玩笑。

嘴角仍保留一点刚才笑过的痕迹。

她轻声问：

“啊？”

表情是笑意未退和轻微担心同时存在，不要突然变成高度紧张或惊恐。

【00:12–00:15｜走近·半身近景·简单自检】

她朝镜头自然走近一步。

男友本能地向后退半步，并略微调整手机角度。

景别自然变成胸口以上的半身近景。

头顶、颈部、两侧肩膀和部分胸口仍然完整留在画面里。

绝不让脸填满画面。

她走近时自动对焦出现一次很短的迟疑，随后重新落在她脸上。

她边靠近边问：

“哪儿啊？”

她把手机当成临时镜子。

下巴稍微收住，眼睛看向镜头附近。

她抬起一只手，只在一侧嘴角轻轻擦一下。

擦完后低头看一眼指尖。

随后轻轻抿一下嘴唇，再抬眼看男友，等待答案。

不要连续加入过多检查动作。

不要同时生成反复擦嘴、舔嘴角、鼓腮、左右抿嘴和快速转眼。

动作保持简单、真实，像一个人真的在确认嘴角是否沾了东西。

【00:15–00:17｜听懂情话·短暂停顿】

画外男声放慢一点，声音柔和，带着藏不住的笑意：

“……沾了一点可爱。”

她听完后出现约0.6–0.8秒的真实停顿。

停顿不是完全僵硬，也不是整张脸突然没有表情。

她擦嘴角的手停在半空一瞬间。

眼睛仍看着男友，轻轻眨一次。

随后视线短暂移向旁边，像是确认自己是不是听到了这么俗的一句话。

嘴角很轻地动一下，但她立刻压住。

她从鼻子里慢慢呼出一口气。

整个反应应该像“被突如其来的土味情话逗到，同时有一点不好意思”，而不是遭到惊吓或瞬间脸红。

【00:17–00:18.5｜很短的假嗔】

她把停在嘴边的手放下来。

先侧眼看男友一下。

轻轻“啧”一声。

头略微偏开，身体向后退小半步。

景别自然回到完整上半身。

她可以用很轻的语气说：

“你真的很无聊诶……”

语气里已经带着压不住的笑，听起来并不生气。

假嗔只持续很短时间。

不要用力皱鼻子，不要把眼睛眯成夸张细缝，不要突然耸肩或做漫画式嫌弃表情。

【00:18.5–00:20｜自然害羞收尾】

她说完后不再刻意表演害羞。

嘴角先压住一下，随后还是慢慢露出一个自然、不完全对称的笑。

她不太好意思继续直视男友。

视线先落到旁边地面，停顿很短，再重新抬起看他一眼。

她可以抬手轻轻碰一下自己的脸侧或把被风吹动的头发别到耳后，但不要整只手掌盖住脸。

肩膀自然放松。

身体轻微侧开，保持四分之三面对镜头。

她用声音稍微放轻、带一点无奈笑意的语气说：

“你真的……很烦诶。”

“烦”并不是真生气，而是情侣之间被逗笑后的口是心非。

说完后，她低头笑一下。

随后又抬眼偷看手机后面的男友。

目光碰上后，她没有继续说话，只是把笑压在嘴角，轻轻呼出一口气。

画面停在上半身景别里：

她稍微侧身，手停在脸侧或耳边，带着一个真实、克制、还没有完全放开的笑看向男友。

不要定格成静态照片。

最后一刻仍保留轻微呼吸、自然眨眼、树叶晃动和手机手持微动。

【声音设计】

全程只使用真实手机同期声。

保留：

近距离男友画外声音
女主角自然说话声
两人的轻微呼吸
女主角压不住的短促笑声
树叶被风吹动的沙沙声
非常轻的远处环境声
偶尔轻微的手机麦克风风噪。

男友声音始终来自镜头后方，不出现画外旁白式录音棚质感。

女主角台词与嘴型自然同步。

说话时允许出现轻微吞字、停顿和带笑气息，不要逐字播音。

无字幕。

无背景音乐。

无音效强化。

【最终强制约束】

全片必须是真正连续的一镜到底。

所有时间段只是同一镜头中的连续表演阶段，不代表切镜。

不能通过人物遮挡镜头制造隐藏转场。

不能突然改变机位、光线、背景、人物距离或时间。

景别顺序保持：

全身中景
→ 腰部以上上半身
→ 胸口以上半身近景
→ 完整上半身结尾。

最近景别仍必须完整保留头顶、双肩、颈部和部分胸口。

绝不出现脸部填满画面的大特写。

严格保持 {{Mixed 1}} 的身份、五官、脸型、发型、发色、体型、服装和气质。

人物的表情必须连续、克制、有理解和反应时间。

禁止：

突然爆红的脸颊
均匀粉色腮红
害羞特效
美颜磨皮
塑料皮肤
五官抽搐
机械式表情切换
夸张瞪眼
夸张皱鼻
动漫式月牙眼
短视频式撒娇表演
过度摇头晃脑
每句台词都配一个手势
无原因大笑
脸部比例变化
换脸
换装
多余手指
手掌遮满镜头
背景跳变
数字变焦
镜头瞬移
隐形剪辑
人像模式边缘错误。

真实感优先于“每条细节都精确执行”。

如果某个微表情无法自然完成，可以减少动作，但不能用更夸张的表情代替。
