text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action science-fiction arena battle. Preserve the bright daytime colosseum look: sunlit sand, strong rim light through dust, monumental stone-and-metal architecture and packed spectator tiers. Keep faces readable in the backlight. Use convincing weight, hard impacts and weathered materials. One location, continuous time.
CHARACTERS AND REFERENCES
@Image 1 = the Executioner, approximately 3.2 m tall. Preserve his pale bald head with a red central stripe, red eyes, black respirator, ivory-and-black armor, red accents, spiked shoulders, back hoses, boots and tabard. His respirator stays on. He has ONE battle-axe with exactly the reference design.
@Image 2 = the Cyborg Beast, approximately 3.2 m high and 4.8 m long. Preserve its four-legged bull body, cloven hooves, dark armor, elongated skull-like metal faceplate, two red eyes, spikes, chains and ornaments. The forehead emblem is not an eye. This image shows its UNDAMAGED starting appearance; later damage permanently overrides its original two-horn silhouette.
The Emperor = one recurring adult man with an uncovered face, a small gold crown and a dark red robe with gold trim, seated on a gilded throne in the elevated imperial box. Establish his face clearly before the fight, then show the SAME man in the ending.
Use the reference sheets for appearance only. Do not display sheet layouts, labels, white backgrounds or duplicate characters.
IRREVERSIBLE HORN STATE
Before the breaking impact: two intact horns attached to the Beast.
At the impact during 19-20s: break ONLY the Beast's anatomical RIGHT horn at its root. In a straight frontal view, this is the horn on the viewer's left.
After that exact impact, through the end: ONE intact LEFT horn remains attached; the RIGHT side has ONLY a short, blunt, jagged stump with a dark mechanical fracture surface. Make the missing-horn gap unmistakable. Keep this damaged side visible in the later combat shots. Camera cuts, changes of angle and the original reference MUST NOT restore or mirror the missing horn.
There is exactly ONE detached right horn. It has the same curve, length, ivory ridges and black pointed tip it had while attached. It has ONE pointed black tip and ONE thick, blunt, irregular broken base. It is not a double-ended crescent, a pair of connected horns or a symmetrical U-shaped object.
The SAME detached horn falls, rests on the sand, is picked up, is thrown and remains embedded in the throne. Its local shape, color, surface markings and broken base never change. Only its position and orientation change.
The axe is a separate object. After the finishing slash, the Executioner plants it in the sand and releases it BEFORE picking up the horn. The axe stays in the arena. The thrown object has no shaft, grip, axe blade or newly added parts.
ACTION, REACTIONS AND CAMERA
The one-second intervals describe choreography, not mandatory cuts. Keep camera movement active in every interval while maintaining readable geography. Show actual contact, not just its aftermath. Use normal speed except for the single finishing slash at 22-23s.
Use a continuous shot across 18-21s to connect the attached horn, the impact, the damaged head and the falling fragment.
Use another continuous shot across 26-29s to connect the pickup, the throw, the horn's flight and its impact beside the Emperor. Then make ONE deliberate cut to his reaction at 29s.
00-01s | Behind the barred gate, exactly two red eyes glow in darkness. A harsh snort blows sand beneath the bars. Camera skims the sand and pushes toward the eyes.
01-02s | Track from the central iron stake along the taut tether to the Executioner's ankle shackle, then tilt toward the axe in his hands and his masked face.
02-03s | AUDIENCE REACTION: a moving medium close-up of three clearly visible front-row spectators. Angry faces, open mouths and forceful thumbs-down gestures; the packed tiers behind them echo the gesture.
03-04s | EMPEROR INTRODUCTION: push toward the seated Emperor's clearly lit, uncovered face. He gives a cold, contemptuous smile and slowly turns his thumb down. Show the gilded backrest beside his head.
04-05s | The Beast smashes through the gate. Retreating low camera catches the breaking bars and its full body charging into sunlight.
05-06s | Track beside its pounding hooves and rattling chains as it accelerates toward the tethered Executioner. Keep the approaching threat and the central stake spatially connected.
06-07s | He cuts the exposed tether chain with one visible downward axe strike. Follow the blade to the broken links as the tension releases.
07-08s | He jumps sideways with the axe. The Beast narrowly misses him and pulverizes the stake. Whip-pan with his escape while retaining the impact in the frame.
08-09s | The Beast brakes and pivots for its second charge. A rising rear-quarter camera move reveals its new attack line and the Executioner waiting ahead.
09-10s | The Executioner drives the axe blade into the sand beside the attack lane, leaving the handle upright. He visibly releases it and raises both empty hands. Push in from his side.
10-11s | He catches one intact horn in each hand. A low three-quarter two-shot shows the contact, bent elbows and the Beast's momentum driving him backward.
11-12s | Track sideways as his boots carve two deep trenches through the sand. The Beast keeps pushing; chains and armor shake under the load.
12-13s | He spreads his stance, drives his heels down and stops the slide. Camera drops to the braking boots, then rises as he twists the horned head sideways.
13-14s | He pivots through his hips and pulls the off-balance Beast onto its flank. Widen with the heavy sideways impact, whipping chains and outward burst of sand.
14-15s | AUDIENCE REACTION: track laterally past the SAME front-row spectators as they spring to their feet, eyes wide, shouting in disbelief. Their contempt has changed to astonishment; the rows behind them rise.
15-16s | Return to the arena. The Executioner strides to the planted axe and visibly retrieves it. Track the handle upward; the Beast scrambles upright behind him in the same frame.
16-17s | The Beast rushes in and hooks its still-intact horns beneath his torso armor, launching him without piercing him. Show the lifting contact before tilting upward with his body.
17-18s | A rising three-quarter camera arc follows him to the apex. He holds the axe in both hands overhead; the Beast remains clearly below him.
18-19s | Begin the uninterrupted horn-breaking shot from the Beast's front-right quarter. The Executioner descends, aiming the axe at the ROOT of its RIGHT horn. Keep that attached horn and the blade visible together.
19-20s | The blade visibly strikes the right horn's root. ONE horn separates with a metallic crack and sparks. Continue the same shot: show the short jagged right stump, the intact left horn and the detached curved horn together. No second horn breaks.
20-21s | Follow the SAME horn as it lands beside the Executioner's landing position, then widen to include the Beast's permanently one-horned head. The horn on the sand has one black tip and one blunt broken base. The Executioner lands holding his axe; the Beast turns.
21-22s | The ONE-HORNED Beast makes its final charge. Track from its front-right side, keeping the short broken RIGHT stump obvious and the single intact LEFT horn visible. The Executioner stays planted.
22-23s | ONE brief slow-motion beat: he turns his torso as the Beast passes and delivers one lateral axe slash through the exposed mechanical drive linkage on its right neck. Track alongside the contact. Its right horn is STILL missing; only metal sparks appear.
23-24s | Return immediately to full speed. The Beast's legs buckle; it slides and collapses into the sand with one intact left horn and the same right stump. Follow the fall as its red eyes fade out.
24-25s | AUDIENCE REACTION: push toward the SAME spectators. Their shouting stops, raised hands lower and their mouths remain slightly open in stunned silence. The whole colosseum becomes quiet.
25-26s | The Executioner plants the SAME axe blade into the sand to his LEFT and releases the handle completely. A moving medium-wide shot shows both empty hands, the stationary axe on his left and the detached horn on the sand to his right.
26-27s | Begin ONE continuous shot. He picks up ONLY the detached RIGHT horn with his RIGHT hand, gripping its thick broken base. Track his hand upward. Clearly show its ivory curve, single black tip and broken base; the axe remains planted separately behind him.
27-28s | Without a cut, he fixes his gaze on the VISIBLE, seated Emperor and throws the horn toward that occupied throne. His left hand is empty. Accelerate from beside his throwing shoulder to follow the SAME curved horn; keep its profile readable.
28-29s | Without a cut or loss of the projectile, track the SAME ivory-and-black horn into the imperial box. The seated Emperor's face and throne are clearly visible. The horn's black TIP embeds in the throne BACKREST immediately beside his face, not in a distant column. Most of the curved ivory horn and its blunt broken base remain outside the backrest. The Emperor recoils, uninjured.
29-30s | CUT TO EMPEROR REACTION: a tight three-quarter close-up shows the SAME Emperor's smile vanish, eyes widen and fingers clamp around the armrests. He freezes in terror while the camera makes a short push-in. Keep the SAME curved horn vibrating beside his face in the frame. End on this unmistakable reaction, not on an empty throne or a pillar.
SOUND
No BGM or musical score. Diegetic effects only: crowd jeers at the start, a shocked roar when the Beast is thrown, then stunned silence after it collapses. Include snorts, masked breathing, heavy chains, pounding hooves, scraping boots, ringing axe metal, breaking iron, stressed machinery and sand impacts. In the quiet ending, emphasize the horn's flight, its hard impact in the throne, the short vibration and the Emperor's sharp involuntary intake of breath. No spoken dialogue, narration or explanatory voices.

FINAL CONTINUITY RULES
Keep the severed ankle tether severed. The axe is planted and retrieved before the aerial attack, then planted again after victory; it remains in the arena during the horn throw and the Emperor reaction. Never put the axe into the throwing hand during the ending.
After the right horn breaks, never show two intact horns on the Beast again. Never switch the damaged side, regrow the horn, attach the ground fragment back to the head or duplicate the fragment.
The detached horn must remain a single curved horn with one black tip and one blunt fractured base in the hand, in flight, embedded in the throne and beside the Emperor's face. No transformation into an axe, spear, sword, handle or two-pointed crescent.
Show the Emperor as an identifiable person before and after the throw. Keep the final impact in the occupied throne backrest beside his face; he is frightened, not physically injured.
No blood, gore, exposed organs, dismembered bodies, magical repair, transformations, additional combatants, energy beams, anime rendering, cartoon styling, plastic-looking CGI, subtitles, captions, watermarks or added logos. Preserve the reference armor emblems. Do not hide the horn fracture or throne impact with dust, shake, a cutaway or excessive motion blur.

text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Target duration: 30 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Photoreal live-action pirate fantasy, cinematic practical textures, fast physical action, dark humor. Bright midday, cloudless blue sky, vivid blue open ocean. One isolated, dense wall of fog surrounds only the ghost ship's arrival; the surrounding sea stays sunlit. Start with the collision already happening, with no introductory shot.

REFERENCE ASSIGNMENTS AND CONTINUITY
@Image 1 = the single human pirate captain. Preserve his reference face, eyepatch placement, beard, decorated dreadlocks, weathered brown tricorn, distressed long coat, reddish sash, belts, boots, curved cutlass and two distinct flintlock pistols. Never mirror his eyepatch.
@Image 2 = the single leader of the ghost ship: the approximately 4.2-meter-tall, muscular gray sea demon. Preserve his curled horns, glowing red eyes, red markings, dark ornate armor, skull ornaments and thick octopus tentacles with suction cups. His tentacles are attached to his own body. He fights with tentacles in this scene.
@Image 3 = the enemy skeleton pirate CREWMEN, appearing as multiple members of the same crew. Preserve their exposed weathered bones, red bandanas, ragged dark pirate clothes, belts, boots and cutlasses. They are ordinary crew, not additional captains or copies of the sea demon.
The captain's allies are living adult human pirates with varied faces and outfits. They become wildly amused and exhilarated during the fight. Keep the two crews visually distinct. Use the reference sheets only for character appearance; never show sheet layouts, labels or reference backgrounds.

GEOGRAPHY, PROPS AND CAMERA
The black ghost ship strikes the pirate ship at an oblique angle, then grinds alongside its starboard side. Both decks remain close enough for boarding and the final confrontation. The captain stays above or on his own deck; the demon attacks from the adjacent ghost ship's bow. Show their positions clearly before close-ups.
The captain uses pistol A once against a skeleton and pistol B once for the finale. Both are single-shot flintlocks; no repeated firing without reloading. The final attack uses his last personally carried rum bottle. A crewmate gives him a different drinking bottle afterward.
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
The one-second intervals are action beats, not a requirement for thirty separate cuts. Link compatible beats with continuous tracking. Alternate readable wide shots, lateral tracking, low angles, controlled whip pans and close-ups. Preserve screen direction. Show attacks connecting before showing their consequences. Keep most action at full speed; use only a tiny speed ramp for the finishing slash. Camera shake is brief and tied to impacts.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION
00–01s: Waterline wide tracking shot. A black ghost-ship prow bursts through the localized fog wall and immediately crashes into the pirate ship's side. A huge spray erupts; railing fragments and timber splinters fly toward the lens. Blue sea and clear sky remain visible.

01–02s: Knee-height tracking across the jolting human deck. Pirates stagger and grab ropes as both ships' cannons fire, recoiling through rolling powder smoke. Fresh wood fragments scatter across the planks; the hulls grind together with crushing weight.

02–03s: A rapid push from the ghost ship's bow into @Image 2's face reveals the demon before the third second. His red eyes flare. In the foreground, a thick gray tentacle clamps around the bow rail, suction cups compressing against wood.

03–04s: Wide view across the gap. @Image 3 skeleton pirates leap and swing from the ghost ship onto the human deck. The camera tracks their movement from the black hull toward the living pirates.

04–05s: Low dolly backward as the first skeletons land hard on the planks and charge with cutlasses. More skeletal crew arrive behind them. Human pirates recover their balance and meet the boarding party.

05–06s: Tight lateral tracking beside a grinning human pirate. His cutlass strikes a skeleton's skull; dry bone fractures visibly, then the whole skeleton collapses into clattering pieces. Show contact and collapse in the same readable movement.

06–07s: A short camera arc follows another human pirate laughing uproariously as he knocks a skeleton's weapon aside and smashes its skull. The enemy falls apart at his boots while the surrounding melee continues.

07–08s: Waist-height tracking reveals @Image 1 driving through the fight. A powerful right-handed cutlass sweep breaks through two charging skeletons, scattering loose bones across the deck. His coat and sash whip with his turn.

08–09s: Three-quarter medium shot. The captain fires pistol A from his left hand into an approaching skeleton. A brief muzzle flash and powder cloud accompany its skull breaking and body collapsing. His right hand keeps the cutlass ready.

09–10s: Continue tracking beside him. He returns the spent pistol A to his belt while cutting down the next attacker with his right hand. Loose bones skid away. He turns his attention toward the adjacent ghost ship.

10–11s: Low-angle push toward the captain. He raises his cutlass above the battle and shouts exactly one clear English command: "Rum!" His expression is fierce and delighted. The nearby human pirates respond with reckless laughter.

11–12s: A fast lateral move passes a row of laughing human pirates holding cloth-topped rum bottles. The cloth tips catch fire, illuminating their excited faces. Keep this a brief cinematic action beat.

12–13s: Rise into a wide tracking view as the pirates throw their burning bottles together. The fiery arcs cross the gap toward the ghost ship; follow the leading bottle without losing the location of either vessel.

13–14s: The camera follows the leading bottle into the ghost ship's rigging. Glass shatters against wood and canvas. A stylized fantasy flash fire races along the tattered sails and mast, turning the black ship into a towering orange blaze.

14–15s: High oblique wide shot of the ghost deck. Skeleton pirates are engulfed in flames and collapse into heaps of scorched bones. Burning sailcloth falls behind them. The blue sky and sea make the fire sharply visible.

15–16s: Descend toward the burning bow. @Image 2 crawls out through the flames, hauling his massive body over broken timbers. His entire silhouette burns, but the gray face, curled horns, armor and tentacles remain recognizable.

16–17s: Low-angle push as the burning sea demon rises with a furious roar. His red eyes lock on the human crew. Several attached tentacles coil back and then lash toward their deck with immense weight.

17–18s: Fast sideways tracking follows a tentacle sweeping living pirates off their feet. They tumble and skid across their own deck, knocking over barrels. Splinters explode from a struck railing; no human dismemberment or blood.

18–19s: Whip pan to the captain as one tentacle coils around his torso below his shoulders. It yanks him off the deck, leaving both arms free. His boots lift toward the demon's face level.

19–20s: Crane upward with the suspended captain, still above the inside edge of his own deck. He sheathes the cutlass with his right hand and pulls his last personal rum bottle from his sash with his left. He gives the raging demon a defiant grin.

20–21s: Tight side view containing the captain, bottle and demon's open mouth. Pulled close to the monster's face, the captain drives the bottle firmly between its jaws. The bottle remains visibly wedged there as he withdraws his left hand.

21–22s: Over the captain's right shoulder, he draws the still-loaded pistol B with his right hand and fires once through the visible bottle. Show the shot breaking the glass, followed immediately by a cinematic orange fireburst engulfing the demon's head. No exposed tissue.

22–23s: Track downward as the demon recoils and the gripping tentacle uncoils. The captain drops free toward his own deck. He releases the spent pistol B and reaches for his cutlass with his right hand.

23–24s: Readable side tracking during the fall. The captain draws the cutlass and slices cleanly through the withdrawing tentacle. A very brief speed ramp emphasizes blade contact; the severed end visibly separates through sparks and smoke, with no blood or wound close-up.

24–25s: Deck-level tracking catches his boots and one knee striking the planks. He slides a short distance, cutlass extended, then rises. The severed tentacle segment lands separately behind him; loose bones rattle from the impact.

25–26s: Crane back to show both ships. The burning ghost ship tears free of the side contact and lists away. The wounded sea demon staggers backward on its collapsing bow as its remaining tentacles withdraw from the human vessel.

26–27s: Wide view from the human deck. The demon and the ghost ship's bow plunge into the blue sea together. Water surges upward, steam billows, and the remaining burning masts tilt as the ship continues to sink.

27–28s: Track through the surviving human pirates raising rum bottles, clinking them together and laughing in triumph. One crewmate hands the captain a fresh, intact, unlit drinking bottle from their supplies. Burning wreckage sinks in the background.

28–29s: Medium close-up. The captain takes a confident swig from the fresh bottle, with the sinking ghost ship clearly behind him. His crew continues its wild celebration around him.

29–30s: A gentle final push into the captain's face. He lowers the bottle and gives a crooked, satisfied grin beneath his tricorn. End on the grin, lively laughter and a final bottle clink, with the burning wreck settling behind him.

AUDIO
No BGM or musical score. Use only diegetic sound: ocean and wind, hull collision, cannon blasts, cracking timber, rattling rigging, boots, cutlass impacts, dry bone breaks, shattering bottles, roaring fire, heavy wet tentacle movement, falling bodies, the demon's roar, pirate laughter, nonverbal battle cries, splashes, steam and bottle clinks.
The captain's single spoken line is exactly "Rum!" in English at 10–11 seconds. Make it clearly audible over the battle. No other intelligible dialogue, narration or singing.

EXCLUSIONS
No subtitles, captions, title cards, logos, watermarks or reference-sheet text. No anime or cartoon rendering. No character merging, role swaps, changing faces, mirrored eyepatch, extra limbs on human pirates, detached tentacles before they are cut, duplicate captains, duplicate demons, automatic-fire flintlocks, or magical replenishment of the captain's bottle.
No blood spray, exposed organs or graphic wounds. Skeleton destruction remains dry bone and debris. Keep impacts, boarding, bottle placement, the shot, the severed tentacle, the landing and the sinking visible. No prolonged slow motion, random camera spins, prolonged opaque smoke or final fade-out.

text: 【参考素材】 @图片1 角色戴耳机打碟的近景；@图片2 角色肖像与面部细节；@图片3 舞台主视觉——紫色巨型光环与张开双臂的姿势；@图片4 道具：全息混音台、发光电缆、堆叠的CRT电视、激光桁架塔；@图片5 全息DJ控制器；@图片6 场景——废弃工厂锐舞现场与人群；@图片7 角色表情表；@图片8 角色背面与侧面三视图（后脑接口与电缆）。@音频1 为配乐，画面全程严格卡@音频1的节拍。 30秒9:16竖屏音乐MV，2D手绘美式漫画/图像小说画风：粗黑墨线勾边，赛璐珞平涂与硬边阴影，底色是暗炭灰与深紫的低饱和色调，主光为紫罗兰与品红霓虹，青色作为点缀光。画风、线条、配色与@图片1至@图片8完全一致，线条稳定干净。只在2.2秒、15.6秒、28.7秒三个重拍上出现一两帧少量青色与品红的数字故障色块（参考@图片2、@图片3），其余时间画面干净。竖屏构图：角色多居画面中轴，上方留给光环、排风扇和代码雨，下方是DJ台与人群。 角色：消瘦的中年男子，面容疲惫，眼窝深陷有黑眼圈，额头和眼角有皱纹，下巴有胡茬，脸上挂着汗珠；银灰色蓬乱的刺猬头，发梢挑染成发光的紫罗兰色；戴细框方形眼镜，镜片会反射屏幕和灯光；头戴银灰色大号头戴式耳机（同@图片1）；后脑勺装有赛博接口，几根发紫光的电缆从头骨接口插入，顺着脖子连到背后的接线盒（同@图片8）；黑色连帽卫衣外穿磨旧的棕橄榄色战术夹克与胸挂背心，带肩带和多个口袋，工装裤，厚重系带作战靴。外形全程与参考图一致，不变脸、不变发型、不变服装。 场景：@图片6 的废弃地下工厂锐舞现场——剥落的红砖墙与拱门、锈蚀的巨型发电机和齿轮机器、舞台上方墙里嵌着两台巨大的工业排风扇、头顶垂挂成束的黑色电缆、管道和铁栏杆走廊，地面弥漫紫色雾气；人群是穿连帽衫、战术背心、戴护目镜、毛线帽和棒球帽的地下锐舞人群。DJ身后是一个巨大的紫色霓虹光环（同@图片3），天花板落下青色的抽象数据代码雨。DJ台是一张工业铁桌：两台带发光大转盘的碟机，中间是混音台（旋钮、推子、交叉推子、彩色打击垫），混音台能向上投射全息波形面板（同@图片4、@图片5）；两侧堆叠着显示雷达网格的旧CRT电视，舞台两侧立着顶端装青色激光器的桁架塔，地上缠绕着发紫光的电缆和插线板（同@图片4）。 音乐同步：配乐143.5 BPM，每拍约0.42秒。每一下底鼓都在画面上有反馈：后脑电缆亮度脉冲、光环与屏幕闪烁、镜头轻微震动。关键节点：2.2秒drop砸下；15.6秒镲片进入新乐句；27.1–28.7秒鼓点全部断掉；28.7秒全部轰然回归。 运镜与表演：像FPV穿越机一样高速飞行——环绕、俯冲、螺旋上升、贴地穿梭、甩镜和急推，带运动模糊，速度变化卡点；以连续飞行镜头为主，在重拍上硬切。他的双手始终在操作设备：搓碟、拧旋钮、推推子、转转盘。除27–28秒的怒吼外，嘴巴不跟人声对口型，保持坏笑、咬牙或专注的表情。 【逐秒分镜】 【0–1秒】镜头从工厂大厅最后方贴地起步，在锐舞人群的黑色剪影之间缓慢向前推进，前景是模糊的兜帽、护目镜和战术背心的肩带。竖屏画面上方，远处舞台上的DJ低着头一动不动，耳机压在银灰色的刺猬头上，双手悬停在两台碟机的转盘上方，转盘尚未转动。后脑接口的紫色电缆只微微发亮，CRT电视上的雷达网格缓慢扫描，身后的紫色光环暗淡无光，头顶的巨型排风扇静止不动。紫色雾气贴着地面缓缓流动，音乐还没进鼓，只有阴森的合成器和人声，画面压抑而安静，持续积蓄张力。 【1–2秒】镜头开始加速前推，同时从地面升到胸口高度，人群剪影向两侧闪开，让出一条直通舞台的通道。DJ缓缓抬起头，眼镜片上闪过一道紫色反光，嘴角勾起一丝坏笑，表情参考@图片7第二排第三个。他的右手高高抬起悬在转盘上方，左手按住交叉推子，全身绷紧，额头的汗珠在灯光下发亮。后脑电缆的光越来越亮，发出细小的电弧，CRT屏幕随着上扬的人声一格一格闪烁亮起。到这一秒末尾，镜头已逼近舞台，画面出现半拍的绝对静止，雾气停止流动，像所有人一起深吸了一口气。 【2–3秒】2.2秒drop砸下的瞬间，他右手重重拍在转盘上开始搓碟，转盘高速旋转，边缘的紫色光圈拉成一圈圈光环。一道紫色环形冲击波从DJ台炸开，身后的巨型光环骤然亮到刺眼，所有CRT电视同时闪白，桁架塔顶的激光器同时射出青色光束，天花板开始落下青色代码雨，头顶的两台排风扇猛地转动起来。前排锐舞者的兜帽被气浪掀起，画面闪过一两帧青色与品红的故障色块。镜头被冲击波震得猛烈一抖，随即甩向左侧，进入高速逆时针环绕，节奏从这一刻完全炸开。 【3–4秒】镜头在腰部高度绕着他高速环绕约九十度，背景的砖墙、锈蚀机器和CRT电视拉出长长的运动模糊。底鼓每一下砸下，他后脑的紫色电缆就同步爆亮一次，光环同步闪一下，镜头随之轻微一震，整个工厂像一颗跳动的心脏。他随着节拍用力点头，刺猬头的发梢跟着一颤一颤，肩膀一下下耸动，左手连续拧动混音台上的均衡旋钮，打击垫随拍子依次亮起彩色光点，眼镜片上掠过一道道激光反光。镜头环绕时始终把他稳稳锁在竖屏中轴上，背景飞速旋转，他却像定点一样纹丝不动。 【4–5秒】镜头急速俯冲到碟机转盘的微距特写：发光的转盘飞速旋转，紫色和青色的光纹一圈圈向外流动，中央的小屏幕上数字飞快跳动。他细长、骨节分明的手指按住转盘前后搓动，节奏严格卡在每一拍上，转盘每次被拉回都甩出一道紫色光弧。汗珠从他的手腕滴落在台面上，被转盘的光照亮。浅景深中背景只剩一片闪烁的紫色光斑，近处能看清碟机上的划痕、旋钮刻度和插着的电缆，画面充满粗粝的机械质感，转盘中心的标记每转一圈就与底鼓同步闪一下。 【5–6秒】镜头从转盘表面猛然拉远并升起，绕到他身后形成过肩视角：前景是他的后脑勺，赛博接口里插着的紫色电缆清晰可见（同@图片8），随拍子一下下脉冲发光。竖屏下方的锐舞人群举起双手，随底鼓整齐跳动，青色激光束扫过一排排兜帽、毛线帽和护目镜，护目镜的镜片反射出点点激光。紫色雾气被激光切成一条条竖直的光柱，镜头持续上升，工厂的纵深感和高度感越来越强，头顶飞转的排风扇和垂挂的电缆逐渐进入画面上方，扇叶的影子随拍子扫过人群。 【6–7秒】镜头升到正上方，变成上帝视角俯拍并缓慢顺时针旋转：DJ台中央，两台飞转的发光转盘像一上一下的两只眼睛，他的刺猬头和耳机在画面中心，后脑的紫色电缆向背后延伸。地上缠绕的发紫光电缆从DJ台向四周铺开，连到电视、桁架塔和插线板，像一张巨大的电路图，每一下底鼓都有一道光脉冲沿电缆向外奔流，把整个画面点亮一次。人群在外圈形成一个黑色的圆环，随节拍向内收缩又向外扩散，像在呼吸。俯拍镜头的旋转速度与转盘转速保持一致，整个画面像是被他亲手搓动。 【7–8秒】镜头从高空垂直俯冲而下，穿过下落的青色代码雨，像穿越机一样急速下坠，在离地面很低的位置猛然刹住，变成极低角度的英雄仰拍，竖屏里他从作战靴到头顶的刺猬头完整入画，身后的紫色光环正好框住他的头。他双手一把将几个推子同时推到顶，随即握拳向前一挥，拳头上缠绕着紫色电弧。CRT电视的雷达网格齐刷刷变成跳动的音频波形，光环亮度骤增，一圈光晕向外扩散。镜头刹停的那一刻正好落在重拍上，地面的雾气被震出一圈涟漪，一直扩散到人群脚下。 【8–9秒】镜头倾斜成荷兰角，低机位向右环绕跟拍。他右手转动转盘，左手敲击彩色打击垫，每敲一下混音台就向上投射出一块半透明的全息波形面板（同@图片4、@图片5），悬浮在他周围，跟着镜头一起旋转。机器人声切片每响一下，所有全息面板同步闪烁，面板上的频谱柱随音乐起伏，边缘的数据流快速滚动。紫色和青色的光映在他的战术夹克、肩带和口袋上，眼镜片里倒映着跳动的波形。他的手指一刻不停，面板在他身边越聚越多，围成一圈缓缓旋转的光环，把他包在中间。 【9–10秒】镜头甩向他的侧脸，变成近景侧面特写，参考@图片1：坏笑的嘴角，深陷的眼窝和皱纹，汗珠顺着太阳穴流下，细框眼镜的镜片里倒映着闪烁的全息屏幕。耳机罩上的指示灯随每一拍闪烁，后脑的电缆随着点头轻轻甩动。背景是虚化的光环和激光，变成一圈圈紫色光斑在拍子上闪动。他用一根手指把滑下来的眼镜推回鼻梁，动作随意又潇洒，随即手指又落回转盘搓了一下，脖子跟着底鼓小幅抽动，整个人沉浸在音乐里，仿佛他和这台机器已经连成一体。 【10–11秒】镜头化身穿越机，从他身后飞出，在锈蚀的巨型发电机和齿轮机器之间高速穿梭，贴着剥落的红砖立柱擦过，钻过垂挂的电缆和铁栏杆走廊，前景电缆在镜头前高速掠过形成模糊的紫色线条。镜头直接穿过一台高速旋转的巨型排风扇的扇叶缝隙，扇叶在画面上切出一道道频闪般的黑影，正好卡在拍子上。然后镜头做一个大回旋急转弯，从另一侧重新冲回舞台，DJ的身影在画面中越来越大，速度感极强，画面边缘带有明显的运动拉丝，锈蚀机器上的铆钉一闪而过。 【11–12秒】正面中景，他双手同时操作：左手连续拧动混音台上的旋钮，右手快速切交叉推子，手速极快却全在拍子上。插入一闪而过的推子特写，推子每次切到底，左右两台碟机的转盘就交替亮起，像左右声道在对话。这一秒末，他把一个大号滤波旋钮慢慢拧到底，旋

text:
Use @ [storyboard ref] only for each P## panel's staging, framing, blocking, screen positions, and direction. Ignore line-sketch artifacts; written beats, references, and global fields define final content.
Use @ [character ref] only for Zeyn's final identity, hair, ornaments, earrings, and flowing black wardrobe.
Do not transfer Zeyn's reference-controlled features or wardrobe to C2.
C2 is a slim adult guest with tied dark hair and a plain indigo kimono.
LOOK + WORLD: Refined cinematic 2D anime, inked contours and watercolor in a rustic tatami chashitsu; hearth and kettle behind Zeyn's left, tokonoma back-right. Amber black-red-gold light with matcha green, natural 50mm depth, thin steam.
ACTION + CAMERA: Exact hands and pauses; insert cuts rise through pour and whisk, then breathe at offering and sip. Controlled pushes and locked details preserve the left-right axis; stillness punctuates.
VFX SYSTEM: Translucent kettle steam and one matcha droplet emerge from their sources and fade naturally.
SOUND: No music; kettle simmer, silk folds, bamboo on ceramic, brisk whisking, soft bowl contact.
BEATS:
P01: Profile ECU, push: Zeyn draws the red silk fukusa from her black sleeve and opens it with one crisp, weighted snap.
P02: High front 3/4 CU, locked: her fingers fold the cloth into exact triangles without disturbing her long sleeves.
P03: Top-down CU, locked: the fukusa crosses the lacquer natsume lid once, leaving the container centered and closed.
P04: Low profile ECU, track: she encloses the bamboo chashaku shaft in the cloth and draws it cleanly through.
P05: High OTS MS, tilt: she lifts the hishaku from the fixed kettle and pours hot water into the single chawan; steam opens briefly.
P06: Profile CU, locked: she settles the chasen tips into the hot water, gently flexing and softening the bamboo tines.
P07: Front 3/4 CU, pan: she empties the bowl into the kensui, then wipes the same chawan interior once with the white chakin.
P08: Profile ECU, push: the chashaku lifts one measured scoop of vivid matcha from the natsume toward the waiting bowl.
P09: Top-down ECU, locked: a second measured scoop lands beside the first, forming two small green mounds at center.
P10: Low front 3/4 CU, tilt: a thin hishaku stream joins the powder while amber light catches the rising steam.
P11: High OTS CU, push: Zeyn drives the chasen in a quick wrist-led W rhythm, sleeves steady while the liquid accelerates.
P12: Top-down ECU, locked: fine even foam spreads across the surface as the whisk slows near the center.
P13: Profile ECU, push: she lifts the chasen vertically; one green droplet hangs, falls into the foam, and disappears.
P14: Front 3/4 MS, track: Zeyn turns the chawan's decorated front toward C2 and slides it across the tatami boundary with both hands.
P15: High OTS CU, locked: after their mutual bow, C2 lifts the bowl on the left palm and makes two small turns so its front faces away.
P16: Low profile MS, pull: C2 takes the first sip, lowers the same bowl to inspect it, and Zeyn reaches toward the next utensil.

text:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic travel film, 16:9 vertical, 4K HDR, photorealistic live-action, premium Chinese travel-commercial quality

A young couple explores a breathtaking ancient Chinese mountain town built along steep hillsides. Traditional wooden buildings with dark tiled roofs, narrow stone stairways, red lanterns, mist-covered mountains and a deep valley surround them. Authentic Chinese architecture and natural environmental details. No fantasy appearance.

0–3s:
Wide establishing shot from behind the couple as they walk slowly up an ancient stone staircase. Hundreds of traditional houses rise dramatically along the mountain behind them. Warm lanterns glow between the buildings while soft morning mist moves through the valley.

3–6s:
Camera smoothly follows the couple from a closer angle. They walk naturally side by side, looking around with genuine curiosity. The woman briefly points toward a beautiful hillside temple while the man looks up at the architecture. Natural walking, subtle gestures and realistic clothing movement.

6–10s:
They reach a small traditional wooden balcony overlooking the enormous mountain valley. Camera moves around them in a smooth cinematic arc, revealing layers of ancient rooftops disappearing into mist-covered mountains. A few birds fly naturally through the distant valley.

10–13s:
The couple continues along a narrow lantern-lined street. Warm light reflects on the slightly wet stone pavement. They pass small traditional shops and wooden houses while distant mountains remain visible between the buildings.

13–15s:
Camera rises smoothly above the couple, revealing the entire ancient mountain town cascading down the hillside, glowing lanterns scattered throughout the architecture and enormous misty mountains surrounding the town. End on a breathtaking cinematic aerial reveal.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic travel documentary, authentic Chinese mountain-town architecture, realistic human movement, natural facial expressions, physically accurate cloth and hair movement, atmospheric mountain mist, realistic stone and wood textures, cinematic depth of field, natural lighting, subtle film grain, smooth gimbal movement, premium tourism commercial, 4K HDR.

CAMERA:
One continuous logical camera movement, smooth tracking, gentle orbit, gradual aerial rise, realistic perspective, natural motion blur, no teleportation, no sudden scene changes.

NEGATIVE:
cartoon, anime, CGI look, fake architecture, distorted buildings, warped stairs, duplicate people, unnatural walking, floating objects, excessive fog, oversaturated colors, flickering, camera jumps, blurry faces, text, subtitles, logos, watermark.

author: @tokyo_Valentine
text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 30-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action gothic action sequence. Manhattan, a vast luxury penthouse on the highest floor of a skyscraper, immediately before sunrise. The interior looks like deep night behind smoked solar-shield glass. Continuous time, no time-lapse. Cold city light becomes orange sunlight only at the climax.

Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.

Use motivated tracking, low angles, overhead reverses, whip-pans, impact push-ins and exterior wide reveals. Each second has deliberate camera movement; this does not require a cut every second. Preserve screen direction, geography, weapon contact and readable silhouettes. Fast attacks, heavy impacts, brief contact holds; no prolonged slow motion.

REFERENCE LOCK:
Image 1 = the priest, the protagonist BEFORE transformation: the exact adult Black man's face, very short black hair, black clerical robes and bronze cross. Human, upright, controlled.
Image 2 = the SAME protagonist AFTER transformation: the exact enclosed angular helmet, glossy black armor, red chest cross and red details. His weapon is a huge serrated greatsword transformed from his bronze cross, using Image 2's weapon design language. It functions as a sword, never a firearm.
Image 3 = Crimson Lord, the vampire king and boss: the exact bald white head, broad towering silhouette, red horned collar, red cloak, chest cross and enormous curved scythe claws. Taller than the knight.
Image 4 = the vampire soldiers ONLY: pale angular faces, slim hunched bodies, matte black clothing, claws and segmented scythe-tipped tails. REMOVE ALL LONG BRAIDS; keep short slicked-back pale hair. They never resemble the priest.
Keep faces, hair, proportions, costumes and weapons separate. Only the priest transforms into the knight. No duplicate protagonist or duplicate boss. References are appearance sheets, not backgrounds; never show their panels or labels.

SPACE AND CAUSALITY:
Elevator at one end, throne opposite, tall black columns along the sides. The top enclosure includes the glass walls, roof and supporting roof beams. The sunrise horizon is unobstructed once this enclosure is removed. A neighboring building's huge screen is visible at an angle through the smoked glazing. It has a fixed "SUNRISE 6:42" notice and a separate live clock initially reading "6:41". Only the live clock changes to "6:42" near the climax.
The priest's white holy light destroys exposed soldiers but is extinguished by the boss. Other soldiers survive behind columns and later attack. Solar-shield glazing keeps direct sunlight out until the knight removes the upper enclosure. The boss dies from sunlight, not from the sword or the holy light.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION:

00-01: A fast aerial skim approaches the dark Manhattan penthouse. The neighboring screen prominently reads "SUNRISE 6:42", with its separate live clock at "6:41". End the move toward the penthouse windows.

01-02: Low backward tracking from the elevator as its doors slide open. The priest steps out immediately, bronze cross on his chest, robes sweeping behind him.

02-03: Cut to a moving overhead reverse: soldiers cling upside down to the ceiling and sideways to the walls. Their heads snap toward the priest together; scythe tails uncurl around the columns.

03-04: Push from his unchanged human face down to the bronze cross as he raises it. A sharp white holy pulse expands into the first advancing wave.

04-05: Track sideways through the impact: exposed soldiers scream and instantly break into dry ash, blown away from him. Show surviving silhouettes sheltered behind side columns.

05-06: Low dolly toward the far throne. Crimson Lord rises to full height, red cloak dragging over the floor, white face entirely unaffected.

06-07: Tight moving close-up: the boss laughs, deliberately grips his OWN chest cross and holds it up in contempt. The incoming white light visibly collapses into darkness before his hand.

07-08: Whip-pan with the boss's scythe-claw backhand. Clearly show contact with the priest's torso and the same priest thrown sideways across the room, still untransformed.

08-09: Lateral tracking follows the priest into a marble wall. The wall bursts into fragments. He lands in a crouch; his bronze cross returns against his chest and pulses red.

09-10: Tight rising track from boots to torso: articulated glossy black armor expands outward from the red chest seal, enclosing the same body over the robes. Plates lock mechanically, never melt.

10-11: Continue upward as shoulder armor locks and the angular helmet closes around his unchanged head. The red chest cross lights up. His armored hand pulls the original bronze cross free.

11-12: Low three-quarter orbit: the cross's shaft telescopes outward and a huge serrated blade unfolds along it. He stands from the crouch as the completed Image 2 knight, firmly holding the greatsword. Show the complete silhouette.

12-13: Overhead tracking reveals surviving soldiers launching from four directions, including the ceiling. Keep the knight centered and the attack lanes distinct.

13-14: Waist-height lateral tracking follows one powerful sword sweep through the first attackers. At blade contact, their bodies split into streams of dry ash, never flesh or bloody pieces.

14-15: Track just above the floor: the knight ducks a scythe tail that destroys a marble bar behind him, then drives upward with a returning cut. More soldiers dissolve into ash.

15-16: Shoulder-level tracking catches one surviving soldier leaping onto the knight's back and clamping its jaws around his fully armored neck.

16-17: A rapid macro push-in clearly shows the fangs hit the solid black neck guard and SNAP. Tooth fragments fly toward the lens; the armor remains intact.

17-18: Snap back to a readable medium shot as the knight pivots and bisects that attacker with his greatsword. Both halves instantly disintegrate into dry ash. The last soldier is gone.

18-19: Low sideways tracking follows Crimson Lord charging through the drifting ash. His giant scythe claws collide with the knight's raised greatsword, throwing a broad fan of sparks.

19-20: Tight lateral orbit follows a rapid exchange of claw strikes and sword parries. Show actual contacts and recoil; sparks illuminate black armor against the boss's white face and red cloak.

20-21: Floor-level tracking: the boss bears down with crossed scythe claws, overpowering the sword guard. The knight slides backward, boots carving two grooves through the marble floor.

21-22: Push toward the knight's visor as he braces, redirects the claws and frees his blade. His head turns slightly toward the neighboring screen while the boss prepares another charge.

22-23: Fast lens push onto the physical screen outside. The separate live clock switches from "6:41" to "6:42"; "SUNRISE 6:42" remains fixed. The penthouse is still shielded from direct sunlight.

23-24: Low three-quarter tracking: the knight plants his feet and commits to ONE enormous rising diagonal slash. The boss raises his claws to block, but the blade deliberately passes above him. A single razor-thin red cutting plane extends from the sword through the upper glass walls and roof supports, above both characters.

24-25: Match the diagonal into a wide exterior view. Show the COMPLETE upper penthouse enclosure cut through along one continuous inclined seam. Glass, roof and beams separate together as one massive upper section. The floor beneath both fighters stays intact.

25-26: Continue the exterior tracking as the severed upper section visibly slides, tilts and falls away from the tower. Huge glass sheets and structural debris cascade outside. Its removal opens a direct path for blazing orange sunrise into the entire penthouse.

26-27: Cut inside and track the advancing sunlight across the floor onto the boss. His confident white face changes to alarm; dry luminous cracks spread through his face and hands as the sunlight reaches them.

27-28: Pull back to show his full body crumbling from the illuminated side into a collapsing cloud of gray ash. His red cloak loses its supporting body and falls; his OWN chest cross and chain drop with it.

28-29: Low moving close-up follows that same cross striking the marble and landing on the empty red cloak. Ash blows out through the open walls. No intact boss or solid remains.

29-30: A final slow rising arc reveals the knight's powerful silhouette against the orange sunrise, serrated sword lowered, red chest cross still faintly visible. Wind pulls at his cloak amid drifting ash and falling glass outside. End with the knight clearly victorious.

SOUND PRIORITIES:
Distant Manhattan traffic, high-altitude wind, elevator mechanisms, measured footsteps, supernatural holy pulse, soldiers' shrieks, the boss's brief contemptuous laugh, wall impact, locking armor, extending sword, sharp metal clashes, cracking fangs, marble destruction, huge structural shearing, cascading glass and the final metallic cross impact. Wind swells when the enclosure opens. No spoken dialogue or narration. All essential story beats must be understandable with sound off.

RESTRICTIONS:
No blood, gore, exposed organs or bloody severed bodies. Defeated vampires become dry ash immediately. No priest/soldier face or hair mixing. No long braids. No shared weapons or copied tails. No premature sunlight inside. No random explosions replacing the building cut or the boss's dissolution. The boss must visibly become ash, leaving the same red cloak and cross.
No subtitles, speech bubbles, title cards, added logos or watermarks. The only readable text is the requested in-world "SUNRISE 6:42" notice and the live clock. Never omit the transformation, broken fangs, complete upper-section removal or final ash collapse.

author: @tokyo_Valentine
text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
SEEDANCE 2.5 — BLADE SHERIFF vs. POLICE GREMLIN — THE GOLD VAULT

Duration: 30 seconds.
Aspect ratio: 16:9.
Style: photorealistic live-action action-thriller with a dry comic payoff. Realistic skin, leather, fur, gold, weight, and cinematic motion blur. Bright, luxurious golden lighting throughout.

Action movie camera work continues every 1 second.

Give every one-second interval a motivated cinematic camera movement. Adjacent intervals may continue the same shot; preserve geography and screen direction.

REFERENCE LOCK

Reference image 1 = BLADE SHERIFF only:
One 188 cm adult man, the exact reference face, swept-back brown hair, beard, black sunglasses, long dark leather trench coat, black shirt, tactical trousers, harness, and black leather engineer boots. One reference-matching revolver in his right-side holster. Maintain his identity and proportions throughout.

Reference image 2 = POLICE GREMLIN only:
Approximately 80 cm tall, enormous triangular ears, purple and pink fur, red eyes, uneven fangs, clawed hands and feet, a long furry tail, a blue police cap with red trim and gold badge, and the reference uniform shoulder patches/armbands. Preserve the reference anatomy and costume.

There are exactly SIX gremlins: one original sentry plus five identical-looking reinforcements. All six use reference image 2, remain approximately 80 cm tall, and retain separate bodies and consistent positions. No additional creatures.

Use both character sheets only for appearance. Do not show their layout, labels, diagrams, or backgrounds.

LOCATION AND CONTINUITY

One enormous bank vault, brightly illuminated by golden ceiling lights. Tall steel shelves packed with neatly stacked gold bars flank a spacious central aisle. A closed briefcase sits on a waist-high central pedestal. An already-open circular vault doorway is visible at the far end.

The original sentry patrols beside the pedestal, initially looking away from the hero's approach. Five reinforcements crouch out of sight behind low gold stacks at the shelf bases.

The hero descends behind the sentry's sightline, lands, disconnects from the rope, and approaches the briefcase. The rope stays behind him near the landing point.

Use shared frames to show the 188 cm hero towering over the 80 cm gremlins. The hero's right hand handles the revolver and later flicks the cap; his left hand carries the briefcase.

The gremlins' extreme sound sensitivity is a fictional creature trait. Their oversized ears reveal both their detection ability and their eventual weakness.

SECOND-BY-SECOND ACTION AND CAMERA

00–01:
Extreme macro on the original sentry's gigantic furry ear. It sharply TWITCHES at the very first instant. A rapid, precise push-in catches the flexing cartilage and individual hairs.

01–02:
Pull back in a low lateral arc to reveal the small sentry in the huge golden vault. Its long tail sways as it keeps watch beside the central pedestal.

02–03:
Crane and tilt toward an open ceiling vent behind the sentry. BLADE SHERIFF silently descends on a taut rope into the aisle.

03–04:
Track downward beside his descending body. His long leather coat hangs with realistic weight; the sentry remains turned away in the background.

04–05:
Push close to his sunglasses. Bright gold shelves and ceiling lights glide across the lenses. He remains intensely focused.

05–06:
Tilt down with him as both boots gently meet the floor. He disconnects from the rope and takes a silent, careful step toward the pedestal.

06–07:
Glide beside his extended right hand as it approaches the briefcase handle without touching it. A subjective heartbeat grows louder and faster.

07–08:
Rise into an extreme close-up of his brow above the sunglasses. One bead of sweat gathers, stretches, and detaches. The heartbeat intensifies.

08–09:
Track the single droplet down to the polished floor. It strikes with one unnaturally distinct, close-miked TIK. The heartbeat cuts off immediately.

09–10:
Whip-pan to the original sentry's ears. Both ears pivot precisely toward BLADE SHERIFF. The camera creeps around toward its newly alert eye.

10–11:
Continue the creeping arc as the sentry slowly turns toward him. Its alert expression becomes a mocking grin, exposing its uneven fangs.

11–12:
Slide laterally across the shelving gaps as FIVE reinforcements rise from crouches behind low gold stacks. Heads, caps, and huge ears emerge in an ominous coordinated reveal.

12–13:
Lift into a clear overhead view: exactly SIX gremlins form a ring around the single hero, with the pedestal just beyond his reach. Establish every attacker's position.

13–14:
Drop to gremlin height and sweep along the ring as all six bare their fangs and ROAR together. The hero stands at the center, dwarfing them.

14–15:
Pull rapidly into a wide, low view as all six crouch, extend their claws, and launch toward the hero simultaneously from their established positions.

15–16:
Enter brief slow motion. Orbit partway around the hero as all six attackers converge through the same physical space, claws leading, ears spread, tails trailing.

16–17:
Track tightly around his right side as he sweeps his coat backward and draws the revolver. The airborne gremlins remain visible beyond the moving coat; the draw is clear and continuous.

17–18:
Tilt sharply along his arm as he points the revolver STRAIGHT UP at the reinforced ceiling. The attackers close in. A tiny moment of near-silence precedes the shot.

18–19:
He fires EXACTLY ONE SHOT upward. Show one muzzle flash and one recoil, with a small distant ceiling impact. Snap to a wide view as a transparent, refractive pressure front expands from the gun through the golden room, bending reflections and lifting fine dust. Return to real-time motion with the report.

19–20:
Punch in on the original sentry as the sound reaches it. Its huge ears fold backward and ripple; its smug expression instantly turns to stunned panic. It grabs both ears and shrieks.

20–21:
Track across the other airborne attackers as they also cover their ears and lose coordination. Their claws stop reaching for the hero. The same single gunshot reverberates through the vault.

21–22:
Low lateral tracking follows the first three gremlins tumbling and sliding onto the floor. Gold bars rattle on their shelves; a few shift and clink, without a shelving collapse.

22–23:
Continue the motion into a wider view as the remaining three land and collapse in a staggered sequence. All six are now down, alive and dazed, clutching their ears. The hero remains upright.

23–24:
Push toward the hero as he calmly lowers the revolver and returns it to the same right-side holster. The original sentry still has its police cap.

24–25:
Track his LEFT hand lifting the closed briefcase cleanly by its handle from the pedestal. The last heavy echoes fade into small metallic rattles.

25–26:
Dolly backward in front of him as he strolls toward the already-open vault doorway, carrying the briefcase in his left hand. His coat swings with each measured step.

26–27:
Move to a low side angle. Beside his path, the original sentry weakly props up its upper body while remaining down on the floor, cap crooked. The hero briefly bends at the waist and knee, bringing his free right hand within natural reach.

27–28:
Tight tracking close-up of ONE casual right-finger flick against the cap brim. The cap pops off and spins away. He immediately straightens and continues walking.

28–29:
Follow the spinning cap down to the floor. It lands, the metal badge gives one tiny CLINK, and the cap settles beside the defeated sentry.

29–30:
Glide into a final close-up of the sentry's exposed ear, which reflexively twitches at that tiny clink. Rack focus to BLADE SHERIFF walking through the open vault doorway in the background, briefcase in hand. End on his unhurried departure and the sentry's humiliated reaction.

SOUND

No BGM, no rhythmic music, no musical stingers, no dialogue, no narration.

Use only environmental and action sound effects:
Faint ventilation, restrained leather movement, the rising subjective heartbeat, the single exaggerated sweat-drop impact, claws scraping metal, six creature roars, coat swish, revolver draw, ONE deep concussive gunshot, layered reflections of that SAME shot, nonverbal creature shrieks, falling bodies, rattling gold, the briefcase handle, measured boot steps, and the final cap-badge clink.

The heartbeat is a subjective tension effect, not a noise the guard hears. The sweat-drop impact is the detection trigger. Make the gunshot feel powerful through contrast and reverberation, without clipping or distortion.

CONSTRAINTS

Preserve the specified action order and the ear-weakness payoff. Slow motion is limited to the converging leap and the draw; keep the rest purposeful and moving.

The one bullet goes upward into the ceiling. The six gremlins are overwhelmed by the fictional sonic effect, not struck by bullets.

No blood, wounds, dismemberment, deaths, extra shots, lasers, magic beams, glowing energy rings, lightning, fireballs, room collapse, or additional combat moves.

No extra people or gremlins, changing scale, swapped costumes, fused bodies, duplicate heroes, floating weapons, teleporting props, or changing briefcases.

Keep the original sentry's cap on until the final finger flick.

No animation, illustration, comic rendering, subtitles, captions, title cards, added logos, or character-sheet text. Preserve the costume emblems visible in the reference.

author: @johnAGI168
text:
Duration：24秒
Aspect ratio：9:16
类型：六人群像，抽象搞笑的金牌导师招生宣传片。

整体风格：
一本正经、用力过猛的导师团队宣传短视频。六位导师依次抱胸亮相，大声说出各自的学科宣言，随后由激情澎湃的男声旁白接管，配合团队群像、金色粒子和层层叠加的励志文案。
人物越认真，宣传包装越夸张，反差越好笑。真人实拍质感，手机直闪般的正面强补光，背景略暗。不要拍成高级时装广告。

六人参考绑定：
@图片1 对应“阿岚”，语文导师。
@图片2 对应“青禾”，数学导师。
@图片3 对应“知夏”，英语导师。
@图片4 对应“白露”，历史导师。
@图片5 对应“墨言”，地理导师。
@图片6 对应“桃桃”，美术导师。

每张图只绑定对应角色，保留各自人物身份、发型、服装和配饰。六人不能串脸或交换造型。参考图的背景、家具、自拍角度及原有姿势不进入视频。后文只使用角色名字。

场景：
傍晚至入夜的庭院草坪，深蓝有云天空，右后方欧式宅邸亮着暖黄色窗光，远处有庭院椅、遮阳伞和小地灯。人物正面补光明亮，背景稍暗。

开场站位：
六人站成横排，留出抱胸动作的空间。
画面从左到右：桃桃、墨言、白露、知夏、青禾、阿岚。
镜头从最右边的阿岚开始，向队列左侧依次横移。前一位滑出画面右侧，下一位进入中央。所有人实际站在同一空间里，不使用变脸转场。

声音总要求：
前9秒由六位角色分别说自己的台词，使用六种略有区别、与人物相符的成年女性声线，普通话清晰，气势自信，短促有力。每句只由当前居中的角色说，嘴型与汉字发音同步。
9秒以后切换为独立的幕后男声旁白：低沉厚实、胸腔共鸣强，像热血招生广告的王牌播音员，语气激情澎湃、坚定昂扬，逐句递进，最后一句达到高潮。不能念成平淡介绍，也不要破音尖叫。
旁白不由画面中的角色说，旁白期间人物不跟着张嘴。
对白、旁白、配乐分层清楚，不相互覆盖。

SHOT 1｜00.00–09.00｜六人依次亮相，各说一句

Camera：
连续沿队列向左横移，保持腰部以上中景和近似人物大小。每位人物居中时短暂停稳，横移时有轻微运动模糊。人物先开口并抬臂，再在句尾完成抱胸，让动作落点、最后一个字和音乐重拍同步。

00.00–01.50｜阿岚，语文
Action：
阿岚直视镜头，双手由身体两侧抬起，一条前臂横扫胸前，另一条跟上，交叉抱胸，肩膀略微侧转。
Performance：
沉稳笃定，嘴角带自信微笑，像在宣布自己的强项。
Dialogue：
“学好语文，出口成章！”
语气前半清楚铺开，后半加重，“章”字说完抱胸定住。
Text：
腹部前方弹出金黄色发光粗体字“语文”。

01.50–03.00｜青禾，数学
Action：
镜头左移，青禾进入中央。抬臂横扫，利落抱胸，轻轻扬眉。
Performance：
语速爽快，干脆自信，带一点“这题还用想”的神气。
Dialogue：
“拿下数学，思路清楚！”
“拿下”有力度，“清楚”果断收尾。
Text：
对应出现“数学”，上一学科标签消失。

03.00–04.50｜知夏，英语
Action：
知夏进入中央，边说边抬起双臂，句尾抱胸，肩膀微侧，头转回镜头。
Performance：
吐字利落，职业感强，从容中带气势。
Dialogue：
“英语开口，自信就有！”
重读“开口”和“自信”，最后保持笃定眼神。
Text：
出现“英语”。

04.50–06.00｜白露，历史
Action：
白露进入中央，双臂抬起幅度更大，随后果断交叉抱胸，挺直身体、抬下巴。
Performance：
六人里最有演讲气势，眼睛稍睁大，认真得略显夸张。
Dialogue：
“以史为鉴，胸有大局！”
“大局”加重，抱胸动作干净落定。
Text：
出现“历史”。

06.00–07.50｜墨言，地理
Action：
墨头进入中央后，墨言从自然站姿抬臂交叉抱胸，轻侧肩，笑看镜头。
Performance：
声音明亮，表达舒展，最后两个字干脆有力。
Dialogue：
“看懂地理，走遍天地！”
重读“地理”和“天地”。
Text：
出现“地理”。

07.50–09.00｜桃桃，美术
Action：
桃桃进入中央，两条前臂由低处向上扫起，交叉收拢，微抬下巴。
Performance：
明亮有冲劲，像为整组个人介绍作压轴。
Dialogue：
“提笔作画，创意开挂！”
“开挂”稍作强调，最后抱胸定住一拍。
Text：
出现“美术”。

Constraints：
六句台词依次说完，不抢话，不同时开口。每人约1.5秒，使用利落的广告短句节奏，不拖长尾音。每人先抬臂再抱胸，动作完整，手臂不穿模。六张脸保持稳定。

SHOT 2｜09.00–14.50｜拉远展示全队，热血旁白接管

09.00–09.60：
镜头迅速拉远并调整构图，短暂径向缩放模糊后恢复清晰，完整露出六人横排。六人仍按原左右顺序抱胸站在草坪上，直视镜头。音乐在此加入更强的鼓点与铜管合成器。

09.30–11.50：
Narration：
“成功——不是偶然！”
男声在“成功”后短暂停顿，“不是偶然”逐字有力量。
Text：
画面中下方出现大号金色立体字：
“成功不是偶然”
文字略侧转后迅速转正，配深色描边和金色外发光，金色粒子开始漂浮。

11.50–14.50：
Narration：
“让优秀，成为习惯！”
“优秀”加重，后半语气上扬但结尾收得坚定。
Text：
第二行出现：
“让优秀成为习惯”

Performance：
六人稳稳站立，只有轻微呼吸、抬下巴和重心调整。知夏短暂松开一条手臂，朝其他导师摊掌介绍，再收回。其他人不同时乱动，不跟随旁白对口型。

Camera：
拉远后固定六人全身群像，脸部清晰，文字位于脸部下方。

SHOT 3｜14.50–24.00｜团队海报，旁白层层推向高潮

Composition：
硬切同一庭院的新构图，前景放置足够三人并排坐下的条纹软包长凳。
后排从左到右：阿岚、知夏、墨言，站立。
前排从左到右：青禾、白露、桃桃，坐下。
后排脸部从前排肩膀之间错开露出，六张脸都完整可见。不得生成第七人。

14.50–17.00：
Action：
六人已经摆好姿势。后排挺直站立、抱胸或双手交叠；前排端正坐好，手自然放在腿上，神情认真自信。
Narration：
“久经沙场！实战为王！”
两句像口号一样有明确落点，第二句更强。
Text：
画面上方出现白色毛笔字、深红厚重阴影：
“久经沙场”
“实战为王”

17.00–18.50：
Narration：
“金牌导师团队！”
男声饱满昂扬，重读“金牌”。
Text：
中下部弹出金红色立体大字：
“金牌导师团队”
标题短促放大后停稳，配一次重鼓。

18.50–20.00：
Narration：
“手把手带教！”
强调“手把手”，语气坚定有力。
Text：
主标题下方增加：
“手把手带教”
Action：
知夏小幅抬起一只手，掌心朝团队介绍，再自然放下，其余人保持姿态。

20.00–24.00：
Narration：
“加入我们！把握机遇！成就更好的自己！”
三句连续递进，句间只作短暂停顿。“加入我们”发出号召，“把握机遇”提高力度，“成就更好的自己”达到全片高潮，最后一个字清晰收住。
Text：
随旁白依次出现三行：
“加入我们”
“把握机遇”
“成就更好的自己！”
采用黄白粗体字与深色描边，文字分层清楚，不遮挡人物脸部。
Action：
六人目光坚定地看向镜头，保持真实微动。最后半秒稳住整幅团队海报，配乐以有力的结束重拍收束。

Style：
人物始终一本正经，宣传文案和声音越来越热血，形成抽象招生广告的反差。金色粒子缓慢漂浮，适量轻微色差闪动，不影响人脸清晰。

Audio：

text:
Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Complete revised sequence: 30 seconds, 16:9, photoreal live-action epic fantasy cinema.
Restore monumental scale, violent impacts, the furious eye close-up, the rotating thrown sword and the backlit victory.

SETTING AND REFERENCES
Daylight in an enormous ancient Roman-inspired fortress. Towering stone curtain walls with a jagged silhouette of deep crenellations enclose a vast sandy courtyard. The high parapets stand far above the Minotaur. Maintain this immense scale throughout, including the hero's leap from the actual TOP of the high wall. Heavy timber gates, weathered blocks, harsh sunlight and airborne grit. Keep the sun fixed in the world; position the final camera so the sun is behind the hero.

@Image 1 = the ONLY hero, approximately 190 cm tall: short dark hair, beard, cheek scars, muscular body, golden armor, ragged pale cloak, boots and the exact reference sword. He remains bareheaded.
@Image 2 = allied bronze infantry: turquoise patina, crested helmets, round shields and worn cloaks. The defenders also carry ordinary handheld spears. All remain helmeted.
@Image 3 = the ONE approximately 4.2 m Minotaur War King: original bull head, head armor, broad forward-curving horns, bone armor, black-and-white body markings, massive axe, furred shins and cloven hooves. The red circular target stays on his anatomical LEFT upper shoulder.
@Image 4 = enemy infantry: dark iron helmets, chainmail, fur cloaks, dark armor, curved swords and round wooden shields. All remain helmeted.
Preserve identities, proportions, materials and equipment. Reference sheets supply appearance only; their text, borders and layout never appear.

WEAPON CONTINUITY — ONE PHYSICAL SWORD
Before the throw, the hero holds his single sword in his RIGHT hand, including through the wall impact.
During 21–22 seconds, show an actual release: his fingers open, the sword leaves, and his hand becomes EMPTY.
During 22–23 seconds, there is exactly one airborne sword, making a controlled end-over-end rotation in slow motion.
During 23–24 seconds, its POINT enters the center of the red shoulder target first. Most of the blade sinks deeply into the shoulder; the guard, hilt and a short section of blade remain outside. The point is buried, never pointing outward from the body.
From impact until the visible extraction during 27–28 seconds, the sword stays rigidly embedded in the SAME shoulder at the SAME depth and angle relative to that shoulder. It moves with the shoulder as the Minotaur staggers and falls backward. The hero remains empty-handed.
The embedded hilt stays clearly visible in the wider views, during the fall, on the supine body and while the hero climbs onto him. Dust, framing and the hero's body must not conceal it.
During 27–28 seconds, show the hero's right hand grasp that exact hilt and pull that exact blade completely free along its entry axis in one continuous action. Only then does he have a sword again.
The extracted sword is the same object raised in the final pose. Never show both an embedded sword and a second sword in his hand.

OTHER PHYSICAL CONTINUITY
Opening spear attacks strike hard chest armor and the outer shoulder rings, never the red center. Shafts snap outside the body and debris falls away. No arrows, bows or lingering spear fragments in the target.
Each furred shin ends above a solid dark hoof with exactly two distinct halves and a clear central cleft. Keep the hard hoof walls and edges visible below the fur.
Preserve a connected head, neck, torso, pelvis and four limbs. Both large horns remain rooted in the skull with the original shape and forward curvature; they rotate only with the head.
The Minotaur falls BACKWARD and finishes SUPINE, chest and muzzle facing upward. Show that transition, rather than cutting from one body orientation to another. His axe lands flat on his right side, clear of his head and the hero's path.

CAMERA AND RHYTHM
Action-movie camerawork continues every second throughout the entire video.
One-second beats describe evolving action, not mandatory hard cuts. Use forceful tracking, low angles, whip-pans, plunging camera movement and brief impact shake, while keeping contact readable.
The kick, flight and wall collision form a continuous side-tracking action.
Use slow motion specifically for the spinning sword; return to real time at penetration.
From the shoulder impact through extraction, use a connected three-quarter camera move from the marked LEFT-shoulder side; widen for the fall and keep the embedded sword visible.
Finish from a very low angle, then slowly crane upward while arcing around the hero, with the sun behind him. Do not replace this with a static wide shot.

SECOND-BY-SECOND SEQUENCE

00–01s:
Inside the monumental fortress, bronze defenders brace overlapping shields against the buckling timber gate. Push low along skidding boots and shaking shields; towering crenellated walls rise behind them.

01–02s:
The gate explodes inward under the Minotaur's impact. Huge splinters, beams and shields fly toward the retreating camera. Soldiers are knocked backward through dust. Physical destruction, not a fireball.

02–03s:
The Minotaur storms through the breach with his axe raised. Track from a crushing hoof strike up to his horned bull head. Human soldiers establish his size; the much higher walls establish the fortress's scale.

03–04s:
Allies thrust their spears against his chest armor and outer shoulder rings. Shafts buckle and snap as the soldiers recoil. Track laterally through the failed impacts; no weapon stays embedded.

04–05s:
Push into the original red shoulder circle, pristine at its center. Broken spear pieces fall past it without entering it. Pull with the shoulder as the Minotaur winds up his axe.

05–06s:
One enormous axe sweep smashes the overlapping shield line. Shields buckle and several allies are hurled sideways together. Follow the axe through visible contact, then whip-pan with the flying soldiers and debris.

06–07s:
Two sharp reaction inserts: a helmeted ally recoils and runs in terror; another crashes into the sand beneath his shield and struggles to rise. Preserve the frantic momentum.

07–08s:
Dark enemy infantry flood through the ruined gate behind the Minotaur. Sweep across the advancing ranks, then whip-tilt up the full towering wall to reveal the golden hero on its highest crenellated parapet.

08–09s:
The hero launches from the TOP of the high wall into the vast drop. A plunging camera follows beside him, showing many courses of stone racing upward behind his falling body. His ragged cloak lashes violently.

09–10s:
Continue the rapid descent into a thunderous courtyard landing. Sand and loose grit erupt around his boots. Swing low toward his bare face and golden armor as he rises immediately into an attack.

10–11s:
He charges alone into the enemy wave, knocks aside the first shield and slashes across the armored attacker, dropping him. Track at waist height through the contact and follow-through.

11–12s:
He parries a second enemy's curved sword and drives a returning slash across armor. The attacker tumbles backward as the camera moves tightly beside the hero's forward advance.

12–13s:
A third enemy attacks from the flank. The hero pivots beneath the blade and slashes him into the next rank. A fast controlled arc reveals the surrounding attackers without losing the hero.

13–14s:
The hero checks a rear attacker with his left elbow and turns into a decisive right-hand sword strike. Whip-pan with the turn to reveal a cleared lane and the approaching Minotaur.

14–15s:
The Minotaur recognizes him and roars, raising the massive axe overhead. Push low past the hero's shoulder toward the towering beast, horns and axe silhouetted against the crenellated walls.

15–16s:
The axe crashes into the paving as the hero rolls aside. Stone splits and chunks blast across the courtyard. Track the roll at ground level, keeping the blade's impact visible.

16–17s:
The Minotaur drives a devastating kick into the hero's breastplate, launching him violently backward into the stone wall within this beat. Track continuously from contact to flight to back-first collision. Spiderweb cracks burst outward from the impact point; stone fragments and dense sand spray outward.

17–18s:
The hero immediately drops from the wall and collapses onto one knee amid falling debris. His chin stays tucked, back rounded and arms bent; no hovering or seated flight. He still grips the sword in his right hand and wipes blood from his mouth with his left as he forces himself up. The spreading wall cracks remain behind him.

18–19s:
EXTREME CLOSE-UP of his eyes and blood-streaked brow. A thin trail of blood runs along his temple and cheek. He stares directly into the camera with furious, narrowed eyes. Push closer with a tiny controlled camera move; hold the rage clearly instead of cutting away immediately.

19–20s:
His gaze shifts from the lens toward the Minotaur's red shoulder target. Follow the eyeline to its central disk as the giant begins charging. The hero sets his stance and draws his sword arm back.

20–21s:
A low three-quarter tracking shot follows the charging legs. Fur ends above clearly defined two-part hooves; each landing drives a sharp burst of dust outward. Lift the framing to establish the clear line between the hero and the left-shoulder target.

21–22s:
The hero forcefully throws his ONE sword overarm from his right hand toward the charging Minotaur. Show the release and the now-empty hand in the same shot. Follow the sword leaving him, with its target ahead.

22–23s:
SLOW-MOTION CLOSE-UP tracking beside the spinning sword. It makes one controlled end-over-end rotation through sunlit dust, revealing the same blade, guard and hilt from the reference. The Minotaur and red circle remain readable ahead. Its point leads as it reaches the target.

23–24s:
Return to real time as the point drives DEEPLY into the exact center of the red shoulder target. The blade stops rotating and locks into the shoulder; the hilt protrudes outward. In the same moving shot, widen to show the Minotaur's violent recoil and sudden loss of strength. Keep the embedded sword unmistakably visible.

24–25s:
The Minotaur staggers backward, knees buckling under his weight, and drops his axe flat on his right side. Continue the three-quarter move without hiding the left shoulder. The embedded hilt moves with his shoulder at an unchanged angle and depth; the hero's hands remain empty.

25–26s:
He falls BACKWARD: hips descend, his broad back and shoulders slam into the courtyard, and his legs settle forward. A heavy ground impact throws dust outward. His chest and muzzle face upward; his head, neck and horns stay attached and anatomically coherent. The sword still protrudes visibly from the same left shoulder, with its hilt clear of the ground and facing the camera side.

26–27s:
The dust stays below the shoulder line. Without cutting away from the embedded sword, the empty-handed hero steps onto the supine Minotaur's broad torso, establishes his footing and leans toward the exposed hilt. The giant remains motionless in the same orientation. Battle noise briefly subsides.

27–28s:
In a clearly readable continuous view, the hero grips the protruding hilt with his RIGHT hand and pulls the original sword fully out of the shoulder along its entry axis. Show the blade emerging and clearing the body. He straightens on the Minotaur's torso with that sword in hand.

28–29s:
Move into a powerful ground-level LOW ANGLE. Standing on the supine Minotaur, the blood-streaked hero raises the recovered sword toward the sky. The sun sits directly behind him, outlining his hair, gold armor, torn cloak and sword with brilliant rim light. Retain enough reflected fill to read his face and armor.

29–30s:
The camera slowly CRANES UPWARD AND ARCS AROUND him, preserving the backlit heroic pose and the fallen Minotaur beneath his boots. The ally who fled begins striking his shield; surviving bronze soldiers join in thunderous shield blows and wordless cheers. The recovered sword remains clearly raised through the final frame.

SOUND
No BGM or musical score. Only synchronized environmental and action sounds: straining and splintering timber, snapping spear shafts, crushing shields, falling armor, footsteps, heavy hoof impacts, sword clashes, the Minotaur's roar, cracking paving, the explosive wall collision, raining stone fragments, breath, wind and sand.
The flying sword has a moving blade whistle; penetration has a single synchronized impact without musical enhancement. The backward fall produces a massive grounded thud and settling debris.
Briefly reduce battle noise during 26–27 seconds, retaining breath and falling grit. Finish with the sword extraction, armor movement, shield blows and wordless human cheers.
No dialogue, narration, lyrics, subtitles, captions, title cards, logos or UI.

FINAL CONTINUITY CONSTRAINTS
No low-wall substitute for the high parapet leap. No gentle wall bump: show radiating spiderweb cracks, flying fragments and dust.
No seated flying pose, wall hovering or raised spread arms.
No arrows, reversed embedded blades, disappearing sword, duplicate sword or sword returning to the hero before extraction.
No knee-slash replacement for the thrown-sword finish.
No prone final body: the Minotaur ends on his BACK, face and chest upward.
No detached horns, changing horn shape, disconnected neck, fused limbs, fur-ball hooves or isolated ground spikes.
No dismemberment, exposed tissue or blood spray. Preserve the hero's visible blood streaks and furious eye close-up.
No cartoon styling, modern objects, reference-sheet layouts or cuts that skip the impact, backward fall, extraction or final rising camera arc.

30 seconds, 16:9, photoreal live-action. One three-story mall atrium at midday. Sunlight through the skylight, wood-paneled balconies, warm shop lights, a central escalator. Damage persists. Action movie camera work continues every 1 second. Carry movement across cuts. Keep the fighters visible and every impact readable; never hold on a frame of only dust or debris.

@ Image1 = The Wave Wanderer, 1.88 m. Black topknot, round red goggles, the same blue-and-ivory wave-print coat in every shot (never plain white, never black), red sash, heavy boots, one katana with a red scabbard.
@ Image2 = One 58 cm hot-pink cruiser skateboard, four black wheels. It appears only at 02–06 and 28–30. Whenever @ Image1 rides @ Image2, both of his boots stay planted on the pink deck.
@ Image3 = Theolagus, one 8 m white biomechanical giant. One skull face only, two dark crescent horns, white fur, armored spine, long tail. Its body is filled with machinery: steel frame, gears, pistons and cables.
@ Image4 = Exactly five Agravis, each 2 m at the shoulder, far smaller than @ Image3. Pale white skin, ridged spiral horns with two downward tusks, long white mane, black claws. No crescent horns. They charge on all fours.

00–01  Track backward. A large crowd of shoppers floods toward the lens. In front, two parents and their daughter in her twenties; she grips her mother's sleeve.
01–02  Pull focus past them. Five @ Image4 smash through the rear storefront windows on all fours. Shoppers scatter left and right.
02–03  Whip up. @ Image1 rides @ Image2 off the upper landing, boots planted on the pink deck, wave-print coat flaring.
03–04  Low beside the black wheels as @ Image1 grinds the escalator handrail on @ Image2. Sparks spray from the trucks.

05–06  @ Image1 stomps the tail of @ Image2, flips it up and kicks it into the face of the leading @ Image4, knocking the beast backward. @ Image1 steps onto the floor and draws his katana. From here he fights on foot.
06–07  The first @ Image4 lunges. @ Image1 cuts through it in one horizontal stroke. It bursts into white ash and dust.
07–08  Two @ Image4 charge from both sides. @ Image1 vanishes, leaving an afterimage. Both claws strike the afterimage and shatter a glass railing.
08–09  @ Image1 reappears above the two @ Image4 and cuts both in one downward arc. Both burst into white ash.
09–10  The fourth @ Image4 rams a column and cracks it. @ Image1 runs along the wall and slashes past it. It crumbles into white ash.
10–11  Side-on. The last @ Image4 sweeps a foreclaw across @ Image1's path. @ Image1 leaps over it.
11–12  Slow only the airborne apex for 0.35 s: glass shards hang in the air as the claw gouges the shop wall. Full speed as @ Image1 lands and cuts the last @ Image4 into white ash.
12–13  Wide across three levels. @ Image3 rears up from the second-floor edge. Its horns smash one bay of the skylight.
13–14  Tilt down with its claw. @ Image3 tears the escalator free, bringing down the adjoining second-floor slab.
14–15  Falling lights and concrete. @ Image1 sprints up the tumbling slabs like a staircase.
15–16  @ Image1 leaps from the highest slab straight at the face of @ Image3.
16–17  @ Image3 swipes. Its claw passes through @ Image1's fading afterimage.
17–18  Whip to the flank of @ Image3 as @ Image1 reappears. Sword meets claw. A visible pressure ring expands and the surrounding windows burst together.
18–19  Orbit @ Image1 and @ Image3 through three blink-fast exchanges, both always in frame.
19–20  Each blade-claw impact sends another pressure ring through a bank of glass.
20–21  @ Image1 drives @ Image3 backward through a wall and a column. Both stay in frame.
21–22  @ Image1 flashes through the breach after @ Image3.
22–23  Follow @ Image1 and @ Image3 down through two stacked balcony floors, still trading blows.
23–24  One final crossing stroke from @ Image1 leaves a thin glint across the chest of @ Image3.
24–25  Drop to boot height. @ Image1 lands on rubble, back to @ Image3. The giant staggers behind him.
25–26  Ease toward the scabbard as @ Image1 slowly sheathes the blade. The rumble dies just before the guard seats.
26–27  On the metallic CLICK, a glowing diagonal line opens across the whole body of @ Image3, revealing gears, pistons and sparking cables inside. Machinery only, no flesh.
27–28  Pull wide. @ Image3 explodes in a burst of fire, sparks and flying metal parts. @ Image1 stands still in the foreground, coat whipping in the blast wind.
28–29  The same @ Image2 rolls out of the smoke to @ Image1's feet. He stops it with one boot. The wheel chatter cuts out.
29–30  Rack focus from the deck to the shop doorway. The daughter, her parents and the other shoppers look up at @ Image1. She releases her mother's sleeve and exhales in relief.

Sound effects only. Crowd footsteps, wheels on tile, metal grinding, shattering glass, cracking concrete, pressure thumps, one dry scabbard click, a mechanical explosion. Bloodless throughout: slashed @ Image4 turn into white ash, @ Image3 contains only machinery. No BGM, dialogue, narration, subtitles, added logos or reference-sheet graphics.

text:
角色A是原创地狱驯兽师：一名明确成年的女性，二十多岁末至三十岁初，高挑健壮，深棕色皮肤，灰绿色浅眼，分层及肩黑发与不整齐刘海，面孔完全原创，不像任何已知角色。她穿黑化钢与深色皮革驯兽师甲：高贴合装甲领，领前有小型青铜扣环；黑金属肩甲带短外刺；无袖贴身胸甲由重叠鳞片状板片组成；皮革护臂、露指装甲手套、宽铆钉腰带、深色长裤、长开衩装甲战裙、随动作轻微晃动的链条与金属件、厚重黑靴。她不持剑盾，只用精准双指手势控制力量，始终冷静，不害怕，不开口，最后只有克制自信的微笑。

角色B是原创地狱巨像，约为女人七倍高，只有一个头、两条极长前肢、两条强壮后肢和一个沉重躯干，姿态像巨型披甲猩猩与史前四足掠食者的混合，但设计完全原创。它有低伏巨大爬行动物头骨，上下重颚塞满不规则象牙色獠牙，黑色火山皮肤带熔红裂纹，头骨、颈、胸、肩覆盖骨质与黑金属层甲，宽阔肋状胸腔由重叠天然甲板保护，巨大肩部有不对称尖刺，长前臂末端各五根厚爪，后肢较短但有力，肩间升起狂乱灰白鬃毛，两根向后弯曲黑角，红色发光眼，额心嵌一枚明亮深红菱形晶体。比例必须稳定，肩高远超女人，一根爪大过她躯干，头部约为她全身两倍高，绝不缩小、漂浮、变形或只剩头部。

六只较小成年翼魔围绕对峙，它们有瘦骨感躯干、反关节腿、长爪臂、短后弯角、窄颅、尖牙和两片真实连接的皮膜翼。它们只作为前景与边缘二级剪影存在，角形、姿态、翼膜破损各有轻微差异，绝不变成克隆。所有角色完全独立，身份、脸部、外形轮廓和肢体数量必须始终清晰，绝不融合，绝不共享肢体，绝不出现手指粘连、翅膀脱离、额外头部或额外肢体。

风格：高级预渲染风格化写实3D CGI，原创AAA黑暗奇幻电影级材质真实度、怪物动画、火焰模拟和虚拟摄影精度。场景在巨大火山洞穴中被雕凿出的废墟地狱圆形剧场：破裂黑玄武岩平台、深处发光岩浆沟、断柱、烧焦雕像、地缝小火、橙褐浓烟柱、坠灰、火星、巨大的阴影洞壁、远处垂直岩浆瀑布，以及背景中像受控火山喷发般弯曲流动的熔橙火流。环境极暗但可读，岩浆、地火和巨像红晶体提供橙红照明，高处裂口落下狭窄冷白光，在女人盔甲边缘和巨像轮廓上形成微弱分离。使用真实热扭曲、体积烟、漂浮余烬、细腻空气颗粒、克制变形镜头光晕，绝非真人、动画、赛璐璐、游戏画面、插画或幻灯片。

镜头规则：原生横屏16:9，无永久黑边，30fps，精确20.00秒。使用虚拟ARRI Alexa 35与Cooke anamorphic镜头语言，28-35mm用于地狱宽景，连续推近中自然过渡到约50mm人像压缩感，但整个片段仍是一个连续镜头，无剪切、无跳切、无转场、无隐藏剪辑、无闪切。允许在同一镜头内形成约五个主要构图段落，但不是实际切镜。构图保持史诗横向间距，镜头低位、贴近地面、危险而克制，不做英雄摆拍、正面炫耀或胜利定格。前18秒移动缓慢、 deliberate、自然时间；最后火攻时镜头随压力波快速真实晃动一次，无全局慢动作、无速度坡变、无过度乱抖。

0.00-4.00秒：镜头从破裂玄武岩地面极低处开始，左、右前景各有一只翼魔蹲伏成黑色剪影，面对画面中心；后方断岩上其他翼魔轻微移动，翼膜抽动，爪子收紧，狭窄头颅追踪烟中逼近的东西。摄影机非常缓慢向前，从两只剪影之间滑入。中央烟雾里先出现一个微弱深红菱形光点，随后浓烟被沉重步伐推开，依次露出巨像额晶、红眼、披甲头骨、巨大肩部和两条长而 planted 的前肢。每一步都压缩关节，震动地面，让小石子跳动，烟尘被向外挤开，但不要一次性露完整身体。

4.00-7.50秒：同一镜头自然推进并升到低位中广角构图，巨像把两只巨大前爪压进地面，抬头并缓慢滚动肩膀，灰白鬃毛被热流托起。额心深红晶体脉冲一次，照亮头骨脊线、湿润獠牙和黑金属甲片。驯兽师从它右前肢旁平静走入画面，两步后停住；她的全高只到巨像肩部很小一段。她站姿挺直，肩放松，下巴略抬。巨像在她身后张开下颚发出低沉非语言 growl，烟从两者腿部滚过，翼魔仍在画面边缘作为紧张剪影。

7.50-10.50秒：镜头继续无剪切地滑成克制50mm感上胸至头部肖像，女人占据前景，巨像巨大而发光的脸在她左肩后方柔焦可读。她先看向画外翼魔，表情中性、评估、冷静。她缓慢抬起右手到脸侧，手腕向外旋转，只竖起食指与中指，其余手指自然折回。一道狭窄深红微光沿两根手指边缘流动。她眼神轻微上移，嘴角形成小而自信的笑。巨像额晶回应更强深红脉冲，红光扫过她的脸颊、眼睛与肩甲，但不改变她的面孔；她绝不开口，嘴唇不动。

10.50-13.50秒：镜头横移到一只近处翼魔张开的爪与颚之间作为前景框，驯兽师在中距离缓缓把手降向腰侧，双指保持伸展直到手势完成。巨像巨大头部贴近她身旁向前俯下，颚略开，几条唾液丝在獠牙间自然拉伸，鼻孔吐出炽热蒸汽。女人只把眼睛转向巨像，身体不转，表情仍稳。最近的翼魔后退半步，翼膜防御性张开；另一只低头，收回伸出的爪手。所有动作分离、真实、有重量。

13.50-15.50秒：同一镜头继续推进到三只翼魔的小群近景。中央翼魔先露牙，随后深红光洗过它的窄脸，它突然停住，眼睛睁大；两侧翼魔快速互看并把翼膜收得更贴近身体。三只各自用不同节奏后撤，脚趾和爪尖刮过玄武岩，石屑被拖开，绝不瞬移、绝不互相融合。画外开始传来巨像更深、更长的吸气，火光在烟后逐渐增强。

15.50-18.00秒：镜头退入最终低位宽景构图，巨像占据中央，驯兽师冷静站在它右前肢旁，翼魔剪影框住左右前景。巨像迈出一次巨大前步，领先爪撞入地面，几道小裂缝张开，灰尘与火星向外喷散。它把头压低到肩间开始吸气，橙色光从肋下、喉底和牙缝之间逐级增强；额晶仍保持独立深红色，不与橙火混为一体。驯兽师完全不动，只有热压把她头发、战裙片和链条向后推，前景翼魔在火焰释放前就开始从中心线慌乱撤开。

18.00-20.00秒：自然高速中，巨像猛地前送头颅，张开重颚，释放一道连续橙白火焰锥直冲前景。必须清楚看到火焰从喉内形成，穿过牙齿之间，仍然附着在口腔并沿明确方向扩展，不能从身体、晶体或地面冒出。最近翼魔用腿和翅膀向两侧扑离，仍可见它们逃出火线，不在火中凭空消失。低机位被压力波震动一次，火舌卷过下方前景，透过火焰仍短暂读到巨像脸、深红额晶和驯兽师不动的黑色轮廓。精确在20.00秒结束于持续喷射中，无淡出、无冻结、无标题、无片尾卡。

声音：只有真实现场音效与环境声，绝无音乐、无配乐、无歌声、无对白、无旁白、无咒语、无可辨识语言，驯兽师嘴唇绝不移动。声音包括沉重怪物脚步、玄武岩震颤、盔甲皮革与链条轻响、翼膜拍动、爪子刮石、深沉非语言低吼、远处洞穴回声、岩浆 crackle、地火噼啪、落石、热呼吸、烟柱翻滚声，以及最终火焰锥释放时的高压轰鸣、空气被挤开的低频冲击和火焰贴地卷过前景的爆裂声。所有声音必须匹配镜头距离、洞穴体积、火焰压力与生物质量。

强制限制：严格原创角色、原创面孔、原创盔甲、原创怪物与符号；正好一名驯兽师、一只地狱巨像、六只翼魔；巨像始终一头、两前肢、两后肢、灰白鬃毛、红眼、单一额心深红菱形晶体；火焰只能从巨像口中喷出；无复制头、无额外肢体、无消失生物、无变甲、无粘连手指、无漂浮手、无脱离翅膀、无缩小怪物、无比例漂移、无穿模；无血液、无 gore、无肢解、无字幕、无文字、无logo、无界面、无水印；动作真实、有重量、有惯性、有压缩、有反冲、有烟尘和火焰环境后果。
